sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，在加利福尼亚州的一处葡萄园内发现了一具女尸。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她曾被斩首，体内的血液也被抽干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 看来她的凶手费尽心机来掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为无名氏。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 随后，侦探们终于知道了她的名字叫艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但是，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“档案档案呈献”推出的全新系列节目，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: The series on Jonestown deals with horrific events.
sentences.zh: 关于琼斯镇的这个系列节目涉及骇人听闻的事件。

sentences.en: The series deals with mass murder and suicide of men, women and children, as well as other abuses.
sentences.zh: 该系列节目涉及对男性、女性和儿童的大屠杀和集体自杀，以及其他虐待行为。

sentences.en: The episodes are graphic and distressing, especially episode 3.
sentences.zh: 这些剧集内容生动且令人痛心，尤其是第3集。

sentences.en: It will not be suitable for all listeners.
sentences.zh: 它并不适合所有听众。

sentences.en: Please use your discretion.
sentences.zh: 请自行斟酌收听。

sentences.en: How very much I've loved you.
sentences.zh: 我是多么地爱你们。

sentences.en: How very much I've tried my best to give you the good life.
sentences.zh: 我是多么尽力地想给你们过上好生活。

sentences.en: How very much I've tried my best to give you the good life.
sentences.zh: 我是多么尽力地想给你们过上好生活。

sentences.en: But, in spite of all of what I've tried, a handful of our people with their lives have made our life impossible.
sentences.zh: 但是，尽管我作出了种种尝试，我们当中一小撮人却用他们的生命让我们的生活无法继续。

sentences.en: There's no way to detach ourselves from what's happened today.
sentences.zh: 我们无法与今天发生的事情撇清关系。

sentences.en: Not only we're in a compound situation, not only are there those who have left and committed the betrayal of the century,
sentences.zh: 我们不仅身处复杂的局面中，不仅有人已经离开并犯下了世纪背叛罪，

sentences.en: some have stolen children from others, and they're in pursuit right now to kill them.
sentences.zh: 还有人从别人那里偷走了孩子，他们现在正追赶着去杀害他们。

sentences.en: Because they stole their children.
sentences.zh: 因为他们偷走了他们的孩子。

sentences.en: And we are sitting here waiting on a powder keg.
sentences.zh: 而我们正坐在一个随时会爆炸的火药桶上等待着。

sentences.en: I don't think this is what we want to do with our babies.
sentences.zh: 我想这不是我们想要对我们的宝贝们做的事。

sentences.en: I don't think that's what we had in mind to do with our babies.
sentences.zh: 我想这并不是我们原本打算对我们的宝贝们做的事。

sentences.en: It was said by the greatest of prophets, some time immemorial, no man takes my life from me, I lay my life down.
sentences.zh: 伟大的先知曾在某个远古时代说过，没有人能夺走我的生命，我是自愿舍弃我的生命。

sentences.en: During the labour day of her first and only child on May 13, 1931,
sentences.zh: 1931年5月13日，在她怀上第一个也是唯一一个孩子临盆的那天，

sentences.en: Lynetta Jones experienced a near-death mystic vision.
sentences.zh: 莱内塔·琼斯经历了一次濒死的神秘幻觉。

sentences.en: The spirit of Lynetta's deceased mother appeared before her.
sentences.zh: 莱内塔已故母亲的灵魂出现在她面前。

sentences.en: The spirit prophesied that Lynetta's newborn baby would one day become a great man.
sentences.zh: 这个灵魂预言莱内塔刚出生的孩子有朝一日会成为一个伟大的人。

sentences.en: Lynetta never wanted to be a mother, but she did believe in destiny.
sentences.zh: 莱内塔从未想过要当母亲，但她确实相信命运。

sentences.en: The vision convinced her she had just given birth to a messiah.
sentences.zh: 这次幻觉让她确信自己刚刚生下了一位救世主。

sentences.en: The brown-eyed, black-haired baby was named James Warren Jones after his father.
sentences.zh: 这个有着棕色眼睛和黑色头发的男孩随父姓，被取名为詹姆斯·沃伦·琼斯。

sentences.en: But everyone called him Jim.
sentences.zh: 但大家都叫他吉姆。

sentences.en: Jim Jones was born in Crete, a small country town in the state of Indiana.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·琼斯出生在印第安纳州的一个小乡村克里特。

sentences.en: Crete consisted of half a dozen farms with a population of only 28 people.
sentences.zh: 克里特只有半打农场，人口仅有28人。

sentences.en: Approximately 80 miles away from the city of Indianapolis,
sentences.zh: 这里距离印第安纳波利斯市大约80英里，

sentences.en: Crete was less a village and more a stop place.
sentences.zh: 与其说克里特是一个村庄，不如说它是一个中转站。

sentences.en: Everyone in Crete lived off the land and rarely ventured beyond the border.
sentences.zh: 克里特的每个人都靠土地谋生，很少踏出边界半步。

sentences.en: Residents grew their own vegetables, raised their own livestock, and picked wild berries.
sentences.zh: 居民们自己种蔬菜、养牲口、采摘野莓。

sentences.en: In Crete, the Jones family lived in a two-storey country farmhouse.
sentences.zh: 在克里特，琼斯一家住在两层的乡间农舍里。

sentences.en: Prior to Jim's birth, his parents James and Lynetta tried to grow corn and soybeans and raise hogs for slaughter on their farm.
sentences.zh: 在吉姆出生之前，他的父母詹姆斯和莱内塔曾试图在他们的农场里种植玉米和大豆，并饲养生猪用于屠宰。

sentences.en: James Jones had some familiarity with farming, but was rarely home.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯·琼斯对农活略知一二，但很少在家。

sentences.en: He worked a manual labour job in construction to keep his family financially afloat.
sentences.zh: 他从事建筑体力活来维持家庭的经济开支。

sentences.en: Lynetta Jones had no farming experience, and she struggled to maintain the property in her husband's absence.
sentences.zh: 莱内塔·琼斯没有任何农活经验，在丈夫不在的情况下，她很难维持这个家。

sentences.en: A World War I veteran, James Jones was caught in a mustard gas attack on the front lines in France.
sentences.zh: 作为第一次世界大战的老兵，詹姆斯·琼斯在法国前线遭遇了一次芥子气袭击。

sentences.en: The burning gas seeped into his lungs, which caused them to deteriorate, and he found it difficult to breathe and talk.
sentences.zh: 灼热的气体渗入他的肺部，导致其恶化，他发现呼吸和说话都变得很困难。

sentences.en: His voice became a raspy and difficult-to-understand growl.
sentences.zh: 他的声音变成了一种刺耳且难以听懂的粗嘎低吼。

sentences.en: To save himself the pain, James avoided talking.
sentences.zh: 为了免受痛苦，詹姆斯尽量不说话。

sentences.en: Long conversations with his wife were impossible, meaning the couple rarely communicated.
sentences.zh: 与妻子进行长谈是不可能的，这意味着夫妻俩很少交流。

sentences.en: They struggled with the never-ending chores on their farm.
sentences.zh: 他们疲于应对农场里没完没了的杂务。

sentences.en: And as the bills piled up, Lynetta often fantasised about escaping her marriage.
sentences.zh: 随着账单越积越多，莱内塔经常幻想逃离这段婚姻。

sentences.en: But she had nowhere else to go.
sentences.zh: 但她无处可去。

sentences.en: Lynetta fell pregnant in 1930 and gave birth to Jim Jones the following year.
sentences.zh: 莱内塔于1930年怀孕，并在次年生下了吉姆·琼斯。

sentences.en: The baby only gave the couple more work to do and put them in an even worse financial situation.
sentences.zh: 这个婴儿不仅给夫妻俩增加了更多的工作，还让他们陷入了更糟的财务状况。

sentences.en: Fatherhood made James an aggressive, chain-smoking alcoholic.
sentences.zh: 为人父使詹姆斯变成了一个好斗、烟不离手的酒鬼。

sentences.en: The economic depression finally defeated the Joneses, and the bank took ownership of their failing farmland in Crete.
sentences.zh: 经济大萧条终于击垮了琼斯一家，银行接管了他们位于克里特日渐破败的农田。

sentences.en: At risk of homelessness, James' parents stepped in to help.
sentences.zh: 面临无家可归的危险时，詹姆斯的父母出手相助了。

sentences.en: They provided the Joneses with a modest home in the nearby midwestern town of Lynn.
sentences.zh: 他们为琼斯一家在附近的中西部城镇林恩提供了一处简朴的住所。

sentences.en: Lynn was also in Indiana, but had a larger population than Crete.
sentences.zh: 林恩也在印第安纳州，但人口比克里特多。

sentences.en: With its bustling town centre, it was a more engaging place for the young family to live.
sentences.zh: 这里有着繁华的市中心，对这个年轻的家庭来说是一个更有吸引力的居住地。

sentences.en: Located in the scruffier area of Lynn, their new home had no working plumbing.
sentences.zh: 他们的新家位于林恩较破旧的地区，没有自来水管道。

sentences.en: James quit his job due to his declining health, so Lynetta picked up odd factory work.
sentences.zh: 由于健康状况恶化，詹姆斯辞去了工作，因此莱内塔接了一些工厂的零活。

sentences.en: At home, James provided no help with cooking, cleaning, or looking after their baby Jim.
sentences.zh: 在家里，詹姆斯对做饭、打扫卫生或照顾婴儿吉姆没有任何帮助。

sentences.en: He suffered multiple breakdowns and was hospitalised for months at a time.
sentences.zh: 他多次精神崩溃，并连续数月住院治疗。

sentences.en: Townsfolk viewed the struggling family sympathetically, but also kept their distance.
sentences.zh: 镇上的人们对这个苦苦挣扎的家庭抱有同情，但也保持着距离。

sentences.en: A cold harshness radiated from the Jones family.
sentences.zh: 一种冰冷严苛的气息从琼斯一家身上散发出来。

sentences.en: There was no affection shared between anybody, and young Jim was rarely shown tenderness from his parents.
sentences.zh: 任何人之间都没有温情可言，年幼的吉姆也很少从父母那里得到温柔对待。

sentences.en: Jim Jones spent his childhood fending for himself, wandering the streets of Lynn alone.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·琼斯的童年是在自力更生中度过的，独自在林恩的街头游荡。

sentences.en: He'd sit in alleyways and play with rats.
sentences.zh: 他会坐在小巷里跟老鼠玩耍。

sentences.en: As an adult, Jim remarked that being from a poor, dysfunctional family was a source of great personal pain.
sentences.zh: 成年后，吉姆曾评论说，来自一个贫穷、功能失调的家庭是他巨大的个人痛苦之源。

sentences.en: It marked his childhood with feelings of neglect, loneliness, and shame.
sentences.zh: 这给他的童年留下了被忽视、孤独和羞耻的感觉。

sentences.en: Making friends was difficult for Jones.
sentences.zh: 琼斯很难交到朋友。

sentences.en: The lack of positive role models in his life fostered a defensive self-centredness within him.
sentences.zh: 他生活中缺乏积极的榜样，这在他内心滋生了一种防御性的自我中心主义。

sentences.en: In primary school, he was an outcaSt.
sentences.zh: 在小学里，他是个局外人。

sentences.en: His principal noted that Jones lacked respect for authority, and had earned the nickname Dennis the Menace.
sentences.zh: 他的校长指出，琼斯缺乏对权威的尊重，并获得了“丹尼斯恶魔”的绰号。

sentences.en: Despite this, he was considered innately intelligent by his teachers.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，他的老师们认为他天生聪明。

sentences.en: A gifted child.
sentences.zh: 一个天才儿童。

sentences.en: The social isolation took its toll, and Jones recalled how it affected him.
sentences.zh: 社交孤立带来了恶果，琼斯回忆了这对他产生的影响。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 引述：

sentences.en: Jim Jones' elderly neighbour took pity on the lonely ten-year-old.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·琼斯年迈的邻居同情这个孤独的十岁男孩。

sentences.en: She took him to her local Pentecostal church to give the isolated boy a sense of community.
sentences.zh: 她带他去当地的五旬节派教堂，给这个孤立的男孩一种社区归属感。

sentences.en: Jim Jones had this to say about the experience.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·琼斯对这段经历有这样一番评价。

sentences.en: Because I was never accepted, or didn't feel accepted, I joined the most extreme Pentecostal church.
sentences.zh: 因为我从未被接纳，或者没有被接纳的感觉，所以我加入了最极端的五旬节派教堂。

sentences.en: They were the rejects of the community.
sentences.zh: 他们是社区里的被抛弃者。

sentences.en: I found immediate acceptance, and I must say, in all honesty, about as much love as I could interpret love.
sentences.zh: 我立刻找到了接纳，而且我必须诚实地说，我得到了我所能理解的差不多所有的爱。

sentences.en: Religion sparked a curiosity in Jones.
sentences.zh: 宗教激发了琼斯的好奇心。

sentences.en: Pentecostal worshippers believed in prophecy, healing, miracles, and speaking in tongues.
sentences.zh: 五旬节派信徒相信预言、治愈、神迹和方言。

sentences.en: When Jones experienced his first Pentecostal mass, it was loud and intense.
sentences.zh: 当琼斯经历他的第一场五旬节派弥撒时，那是喧闹而热烈的。

sentences.en: It featured fanatical behaviour such as yelling, crying, chanting, and cheering.
sentences.zh: 它充满了狂热的行为，如大喊大叫、哭泣、吟唱和欢呼。

sentences.en: Leading the mass was a charismatic preacher who radiated positivity and power.
sentences.zh: 主持弥撒的是一位富有个人魅力的传道人，他散发着积极的能量和力量。

sentences.en: This mass shaped Jones' understanding of worship being an intensely emotional experience to devotees.
sentences.zh: 这场弥撒塑造了琼斯对崇拜的理解，即对信徒而言这是一种强烈的情感体验。

sentences.en: The Pentecostal church community became a surrogate family for Jones, and he couldn't wait for Sundays to arrive so he could go to mass.
sentences.zh: 五旬节派教会社区成了琼斯的替代家庭，他迫不及待地盼着星期天的到来，这样他就可以去参加弥撒了。

sentences.en: When Jones' parents neglected church, their sinful disobedience became a local transgression.
sentences.zh: 当琼斯的父母忽视教会时，他们这种有罪的悖逆行为便成了当地的一桩丑闻。

sentences.en: Lynn was a religious town, but Lenetta Jones was sceptical of religion.
sentences.zh: 林恩是一个宗教色彩浓厚的城镇，但莱内塔·琼斯对宗教持怀疑态度。

sentences.en: She believed in spirits, reincarnation, and destiny, but not in God.
sentences.zh: 她相信灵魂、轮回和命运，但不相信上帝。

sentences.en: Lenetta kept her son up late discussing grand concepts such as the meaning of life.
sentences.zh: 莱内塔让儿子熬夜讨论诸如生命意义之类的宏大概念。

sentences.en: She called Jones an underdog, and reminded him constantly of his great destiny that she had foreseen.
sentences.zh: 她称琼斯为底层人，并不断提醒他自己所预见的他的伟大命运。

sentences.en: She called anyone who criticised him oppressors, and she often talked about social inequality.
sentences.zh: 她把任何批评他的人称为压迫者，并且经常谈论社会不平等。

sentences.en: Lenetta also imparted her love of animals onto her son.
sentences.zh: 莱内塔还将她对动物的爱传给了儿子。

sentences.en: So Jones started gathering chickens, cats, dogs, snakes, and other creatures, and kept them in the barn near his home.
sentences.zh: 于是琼斯开始搜罗小鸡、猫、狗、蛇和其他动物，把它们养在家里附近的谷仓里。

sentences.en: With candles and flowers, he built an altar in the barn, and preached to his animal flock.
sentences.zh: 他用蜡烛和鲜花在谷仓里建了一个圣坛，并向他的动物群众讲道。

sentences.en: He also delivered rousing sermons at mock funerals held for dead animals.
sentences.zh: 他还为死去的动物举办模拟葬礼并发表慷慨激昂的布道。

sentences.en: One local child claimed Jones killed a neighbourhood cat for his ritualistic ceremonies.
sentences.zh: 当地一个孩子声称琼斯为了他的仪式杀害了一只邻居家的猫。

sentences.en: He also attempted to heal dead animals by performing messy interspecies blood transfusions and limb grafts.
sentences.zh: 他还试图通过实施混乱的跨物种输血和肢体移植来治愈死去的动物。

sentences.en: Other children viewed Jones as a weird kid, obsessed with religion and death.
sentences.zh: 其他孩子视琼斯为一个奇怪的孩子，痴迷于宗教和死亡。

sentences.en: It wasn't until Jones had religious-themed nightmares that Lenetta put a stop to his Pentecostal church visits.
sentences.zh: 直到琼斯做起了带有宗教主题的噩梦，莱内塔才制止了他去五旬节派教堂参观。

sentences.en: As a teenager, Jim Jones had no interest in sport or socialising.
sentences.zh: 作为一个青少年，吉姆·琼斯对运动或社交毫无兴趣。

sentences.en: He saw dancing and drinking alcohol as sinful.
sentences.zh: 他视跳舞和饮酒为罪恶。

sentences.en: Instead, he kept his face deep in books, and his mind lost in political thought.
sentences.zh: 相反，他整日埋头书本，心神沉浸在政治思考中。

sentences.en: He studied the strengths and weaknesses of influential leaders, revolutionaries, and dictators, such as Joseph Stalin, Karl Marx, Mao Zedong, Mahatma Gandhi, and Adolf Hitler.
sentences.zh: 他研究了有影响力的领袖、革命家和独裁者的优势与劣势，例如约瑟夫·斯大林、卡尔·马克思、毛泽东、圣雄甘地和阿道夫·希特勒。

sentences.en: From his study, Jones began to shape a self-styled theology that combined aspects of an ideal society with experiences through God.
sentences.zh: 通过研究，琼斯开始形成一种自创的神学，将理想社会的各个方面与通过上帝获得的体验结合起来。

sentences.en: By the mid-1940s, Jim Jones created a mock church called God's House.
sentences.zh: 到20世纪40年代中期，吉姆·琼斯创立了一个名为“上帝之家”的模拟教会。

sentences.en: He would invite school acquaintances into the loft above his family's garage to attend his Mass.
sentences.zh: 他会邀请学校的熟人到他家车库上方的阁楼里参加他的弥撒。

sentences.en: He locked his visitors inside the loft and refused to release them until he deemed his Mass was complete.
sentences.zh: 他把来访者锁在阁楼里，直到他认为弥撒结束才肯放他们走。

sentences.en: His sermons would carry on late into the night.
sentences.zh: 他的讲道往往会持续到深夜。

sentences.en: One night, Jim Jones' childhood friend, Donald Foreman, was at one of these sermons.
sentences.zh: 一天晚上，吉姆·琼斯的童年朋友唐纳德·福尔曼参加了这样一场讲道。

sentences.en: Donald wanted to go home, but Jones implored him to stay.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德想回家，但琼斯恳求他留下来。

sentences.en: Donald ended up leaving, and he walked out the front door and onto the porch.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德最终还是离开了，他走出了前门，来到了门廊上。

sentences.en: When he glanced back, Jones was holding his father's pistol and said,
sentences.zh: 当他回头看时，琼斯拿着他父亲的手枪说道：

sentences.en: Just stop, or I'll shoot you.
sentences.zh: 立刻停下，否则我开枪了。

sentences.en: Donald walked quickly to the tree-lined sidewalk.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德快步走向树木林立的人行道。

sentences.en: Jones fired the gun.
sentences.zh: 琼斯开枪了。

sentences.en: The bullet pierced the tree Donald had passed just seconds earlier.
sentences.zh: 子弹击穿了唐纳德几秒钟前刚刚走过的那棵树。

sentences.en: Donald ducked and ran.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德急忙躲闪并跑开了。

sentences.en: When he was out of sight, he snuck a look back.
sentences.zh: 当他消失在视线之外时，他偷偷回头看了一眼。

sentences.en: Jones was standing on the porch watching, with the gun hanging at his side.
sentences.zh: 琼斯正站在门廊上注视着，枪垂在身体两侧。

sentences.en: From birth, Jim Jones witnessed firsthand the discrimination, segregation, and isolation of the African-American community in his hometown.
sentences.zh: 从出生起，吉姆·琼斯就亲眼目睹了家乡非裔美国人社区所遭受的歧视、隔离和孤立。

sentences.en: He related their plight to his own feelings of being a social outcaSt.
sentences.zh: 他将他们的困境与自己身为社会边缘人的感受联系在一起。

sentences.en: At 16 years old, Jones created a makeshift church minister's robe out of bedsheets and began preaching on street corners in mixed-race neighborhoods.
sentences.zh: 16岁时，琼斯用床单做了一件临时教堂牧师长袍，开始在种族混居街区的街角传教。

sentences.en: His message?
sentences.zh: 他的信息是什么？

sentences.en: Break down the social constructs that divide, such as race, gender, and age, and unite all people equally.
sentences.zh: 打破诸如种族、性别和年龄等造成分裂的社会结构，让所有人平等团结。

sentences.en: It was known that James Jones, Jim's father, associated with the extremist white supremacist group, the Ku Klux Klan.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，吉姆的父亲詹姆斯·琼斯曾与极端白人至上主义组织3K党有来往。

sentences.en: When Jones came out with his message of racial equality, his father was furious and declared that people of color were not permitted into their family home.
sentences.zh: 当琼斯发表他的种族平等言论时，他的父亲勃然大怒，并宣称不允许有色人种进入他们的家庭住宅。

sentences.en: Jones refused to speak to his father, and during his late teens, his parents separated.
sentences.zh: 琼斯拒绝跟父亲说话，并在他快成年时，他的父母分居了。

sentences.en: Jones moved with his mother to the city of Richmond in east-central Indiana.
sentences.zh: 琼斯和母亲一起搬到了印第安纳州中东部的里士满市。

sentences.en: Richmond was a racially segregated town.
sentences.zh: 里士满是一个按种族隔离的城镇。

sentences.en: When Jones arrived preaching his views of racial equality, it was a welcome surprise for the local black community, and he was quick to make friends with them.
sentences.zh: 当琼斯带着他的种族平等观点来到这里时，这对当地的黑人社区来说是一个惊喜，他很快就和他们交上了朋友。

sentences.en: Between school hours, Jim worked part-time as an orderly at Richmond's Reed Memorial Hospital.
sentences.zh: 在上学之余，吉姆在里士满的里德纪念医院做兼职护工。

sentences.en: During one shift, 18-year-old senior nurse-in-training Marceline Baldwin called for an orderly as a young pregnant woman had just died.
sentences.zh: 在一次值班期间，18岁的见习护士长马塞尔因·鲍德温呼叫了一名护工，因为一名年轻的孕妇刚去世。

sentences.en: The orderly who arrived was only a high school senior, but his tenderness, empathy, and maturity was beyond his years.
sentences.zh: 赶来的护工只是一名高中毕业生，但他展现出的温柔、同理心和成熟超出了他的年龄。

sentences.en: He genuinely cared for the deceased woman's family, and Marceline was impressed by him.
sentences.zh: 他真诚地关心死者的家属，马塞尔因对他的印象很深。

sentences.en: The orderly was Jim Jones.
sentences.zh: 这个护工就是吉姆·琼斯。

sentences.en: Marceline May Baldwin, nicknamed Marcy, was a gentle and giving person.
sentences.zh: 马塞尔因·梅·鲍德温，昵称马西，是一个温柔且乐于奉献的人。

sentences.en: She inherited her parents' kind and loyal conviction.
sentences.zh: 她继承了父母善良且坚定的信念。

sentences.en: With her deep compassion for others, also came an unflinching sense of honesty, and at times, a firm hand.
sentences.zh: 在对他人怀有深切同情心的同时，她也有一种坚定不移的诚实感，有时甚至手段严厉。

sentences.en: She spoke her mind if she thought it would help, and her honest words could comfort and sting at the same time.
sentences.zh: 如果她认为有帮助就会直抒己见，她诚实的话语既能安慰人也能刺痛人。

sentences.en: When Marceline met Jim Jones, she was drawn to him.
sentences.zh: 当马塞尔因遇到吉姆·琼斯时，她被他吸引了。

sentences.en: He was handsome with his dark eyes, square jaw, and slicked-back hair.
sentences.zh: 他长得很帅，有着黑色的眼睛、方下巴和往后梳得整整齐齐的头发。

sentences.en: His reassuring intellect, ambition, and brilliance shone brightly from his personality.
sentences.zh: 他那令人安心的才智、雄心和才华从他的个性中闪耀出来。

sentences.en: They shared an empathetic view towards the ill, aged, and socially disadvantaged.
sentences.zh: 他们对病人、老人和弱势群体抱有同样的同理心。

sentences.en: Marceline recalled, quote,
sentences.zh: 马塞尔因回忆道，引述：

sentences.en: Jim made me know the importance of finding each injustice as you came to it, whether it was one person or a hundred people.
sentences.zh: 吉姆让我懂得了无论面对一个人还是一百个人，都要在发现不公的萌芽时就去指出它的重要性。

sentences.en: At the time they met, Marceline believed in God, attended church, and participated in prayer.
sentences.zh: 在他们相遇时，玛瑟琳信仰上帝，去教堂做礼拜，并参与祈祷。

sentences.en: Jones had become agnostic.
sentences.zh: 琼斯已经成了一个不可知论者。

sentences.en: He didn't disbelieve the existence of God, but he didn't worship one either.
sentences.zh: 他不否认上帝的存在，但也不崇拜上帝。

sentences.en: To Marceline Baldwin, Jim Jones was an open book.
sentences.zh: 对于玛瑟琳·鲍德温来说，吉姆·琼斯就像一本翻开的书。

sentences.en: He spoke of climbing a ladder to perfection by basing decisions on the mantra of saying no to selfishness and yes to love.
sentences.zh: 他谈到要通过把决定建立在对自私说不、对爱说是的座右铭上来攀登通往完美的阶梯。

sentences.en: He told her that life was made up of decisions, that we may choose others or self, love or hate, life or death.
sentences.zh: 他告诉她，生活是由一个个决定组成的，我们可能会选择他人或自己、爱或恨、生或死。

sentences.en: Jones graduated high school in Richmond with honours in December 1948.
sentences.zh: 1948年12月，琼斯以优异成绩从里士满高中毕业。

sentences.en: Afterwards, he attended Indiana State University and earned a straight-A average.
sentences.zh: 此后，他入读印第安纳州立大学，取得了全A的平均成绩。

sentences.en: During this time, his old personality traits reappeared.
sentences.zh: 在此期间，他过去的性格特征又重新显露出来。

sentences.en: He became an outcast amongst his university peers.
sentences.zh: 他在大学同龄人中成了一个局外人。

sentences.en: His roommate, Kenneth Lemons, recalled Jones was a loner.
sentences.zh: 他的室友肯尼斯·莱蒙回忆说，琼斯是个独行侠。

sentences.en: He said everyone in the dorm got along beautifully, except for Jones, who didn't have one friend from the time he moved in until the time he moved out.
sentences.zh: 他说宿舍里的每个人都相处得很好，除了琼斯，从他搬进来一直到搬出去，他连一个朋友都没有。

sentences.en: One day, Jones witnessed an impressive speech given by ex-First Lady Eleanor Roosevelt.
sentences.zh: 一天，琼斯目睹了前第一夫人埃莉诺·罗斯福发表的一场令人印象深刻的演讲。

sentences.en: Eleanor spoke passionately about the plight of African Americans in American society.
sentences.zh: 埃莉诺充满激情地讲述了美国社会中非裔美国人的困境。

sentences.en: The speech complimented Jones' desire for equality and reignited his passion to enact positive change.
sentences.zh: 这场演讲迎合了琼斯对平等的渴望，并重新点燃了他推动积极变革的热情。

sentences.en: Jones quit a basketball team when his coach was racist towards black players.
sentences.zh: 当教练对黑人球员表现出种族歧视时，琼斯退出了篮球队。

sentences.en: He defiantly walked out of a barbershop when the barber refused to cut the hair of a black man.
sentences.zh: 当理发师拒绝为一个黑人理发时，他挑衅地走出了理发店。

sentences.en: A man who picked Jones up hitchhiking started talking about African Americans in a derogatory manner, so Jones demanded he stop the car and let him out.
sentences.zh: 一个顺路搭便车接了琼斯的人开始以贬低的方式谈论非裔美国人，于是琼斯要求他停车并让自己下车。

sentences.en: In 1949, 18-year-old Jim Jones married 22-year-old Marceline Baldwin.
sentences.zh: 1949年，18岁的吉姆·琼斯与22岁的玛瑟琳·鲍德温结婚了。

sentences.en: Together, they moved to Bloomington, a city in the southern region of Indiana.
sentences.zh: 他们一起搬到了印第安纳州南部的一个城市布卢明顿。

sentences.en: The newlyweds visited their parents during the summer.
sentences.zh: 这对新婚夫妇在夏天拜访了他们的父母。

sentences.en: During one visit, Marceline's mother started talking about how it wasn't Christian for racers to intermarry.
sentences.zh: 在一次拜访中，玛瑟琳的母亲开始谈论种族通婚是如何不符合基督教教义的。

sentences.en: Jones was offended by the comment and he packed his things and left.
sentences.zh: 琼斯对这番言论感到被冒犯，于是收拾好东西离开了。

sentences.en: He ignored Marceline's family afterwards and left any room they were in.
sentences.zh: 此后他一直不理睬玛瑟琳的家人，只要他们在同一个房间他就会离开。

sentences.en: There was no compromise in Jones.
sentences.zh: 在琼斯身上没有任何妥协可言。

sentences.en: This went on for months until Marceline's mother apologised.
sentences.zh: 这种情况持续了几个月，直到玛瑟琳的母亲道歉。

sentences.en: Marceline's mother's comment fuelled Jim Jones to attack the entrenched racism that festered in Christian churches.
sentences.zh: 玛瑟琳母亲的言论促使吉姆·琼斯向滋生于基督教堂中的根深蒂固的种族主义发起了攻击。

sentences.en: In 1952, despite still being agnostic, Jones became a student pastor in Indianapolis.
sentences.zh: 1952年，尽管仍然是个不可知论者，琼斯还是成为了印第安纳波利斯的一名学生牧师。

sentences.en: For four years, he focused on integrating the local church congregation.
sentences.zh: 在四年时间里，他专注于实现当地教堂会众的融合。

sentences.en: But he failed.
sentences.zh: 但他失败了。

sentences.en: White families would leave when black worshippers entered the church.
sentences.zh: 当黑人信徒进入教堂时，白人家庭就会离开。

sentences.en: Jim Jones, quote,
sentences.zh: 吉姆·琼斯原话说道，

sentences.en: It was one thing for white believers to nod in passive agreement when their preacher said that all humans were created equal in the eyes of God.
sentences.zh: 当布道者说所有人在上帝面前生而平等时，白人信徒点头表示被动同意是一回事。

sentences.en: It was quite another to stand shoulder to shoulder with a black person.
sentences.zh: 而要与一个黑人并肩站在一起则是完全另一回事。

sentences.en: When complaints from the congregation about Jim Jones' integration attempts reached the church board, they decided not to invite the radical student minister back to their church.
sentences.zh: 当来自会众的关于吉姆·琼斯种族融合尝试的投诉传到教堂董事会时，他们决定不再邀请这位激进的学生牧师回到他们的教堂。

sentences.en: Jim and Marceline Jones started what they called their Rainbow Family by adopting children of non-Caucasian ancestry.
sentences.zh: 吉姆和玛瑟琳·琼斯通过收养非高加索血统的孩子，开始了他们所谓的彩虹家庭。

sentences.en: They first adopted three Korean-American children, Lou, Suzanne, and Stephanie.
sentences.zh: 他们首先收养了三个韩裔美国孩子，露、苏珊和斯蒂芬妮。

sentences.en: Then they adopted Agnes, who was of Native American descent.
sentences.zh: 然后他们收养了有美洲原住民血统的阿格妮丝。

sentences.en: Then they adopted Tim, who was Caucasian.
sentences.zh: 接着他们收养了白人男孩蒂姆。

sentences.en: They had one biological child together, a son, Stephen.
sentences.zh: 他们共同育有一个亲生孩子，即儿子斯蒂芬。

sentences.en: Then they adopted an African-American baby boy named James Warren Jones Jr.
sentences.zh: 然后他们收养了一个名叫小詹姆斯·沃伦·琼斯的非裔美国男婴。

sentences.en: Jim and Marceline were the first white couple in Indiana to adopt a black child.
sentences.zh: 吉姆和玛瑟琳是印第安纳州第一对收养黑人孩子的白人夫妇。

sentences.en: When Marceline walked the street with her baby, a local white woman spat at her.
sentences.zh: 当玛瑟琳带着她的婴儿走在街上时，当地的一个白人妇女向她吐口水。

sentences.en: Marceline was afraid of a violent public backlash and begged Jones to move their family away.
sentences.zh: 玛瑟琳害怕遭到公众的暴力反弹，恳求琼斯把他们的家人搬走。

sentences.en: But he refused.
sentences.zh: 但他拒绝了。

sentences.en: He told Marceline how could his children learn what he believed in if they didn't live it.
sentences.zh: 他告诉玛瑟琳，如果孩子们没有亲身体验，又怎么能学会他所信仰的东西呢。

sentences.en: Jones helped racially integrate churches, restaurants, a telephone company, the police department, a theatre, an amusement park, and a hospital.
sentences.zh: 琼斯帮助实现了教堂、餐馆、一家电话公司、警察局、一家剧院、一家游乐园和一个医院的种族融合。

sentences.en: One minister later remarked, quote,
sentences.zh: 一位牧师后来评论说，原话是，

sentences.en: He wrote,
sentences.zh: 他写道，

sentences.en: One Sunday afternoon, Jones visited a church in Indianapolis.
sentences.zh: 一个星期天下午，琼斯造访了印第安纳波利斯的一座教堂。

sentences.en: The church's pastor was a personal friend.
sentences.zh: 该教堂的牧师是他的私交好友。

sentences.en: The church was packed for the service, and Jones noticed African-American worshippers were seated at the back of the church.
sentences.zh: 教堂里的礼拜座无虚席，琼斯注意到非裔美国信徒坐在教堂的最后面。

sentences.en: Jones called them forward and let them sit on the preacher's stage.
sentences.zh: 琼斯把他们叫到前面，让他们坐在布道台上。

sentences.en: This radical action caused conflict between Jones and the church board.
sentences.zh: 这一激进举动导致琼斯与教堂董事会之间产生了冲突。

sentences.en: Not only did they not want black people sitting on the preacher's stage, they didn't want them attending their church at all.
sentences.zh: 他们不仅不希望黑人坐在布道台上，甚至根本不希望他们来教堂参加礼拜。

sentences.en: However, charismatic and caring Jim Jones was a membership and financial drawing card for the church board, and they didn't want to lose his support.
sentences.zh: 然而，富有个人魅力且关心他人的吉姆·琼斯是教堂董事会的会员和资金吸引力来源，他们不想失去对他的支持。

sentences.en: As a compromise, they offered him the opportunity to establish his own church in an African-American neighbourhood.
sentences.zh: 作为妥协，他们为他提供了一个在非裔美国人社区建立自己的教堂的机会。

sentences.en: Jones replied,
sentences.zh: 琼斯回答说，

sentences.en: There will be no church in the black neighbourhood.
sentences.zh: 黑人社区里不会有教堂。

sentences.en: I will not be a pastor of a black church or a white church.
sentences.zh: 我不会成为黑人教堂或白人教堂的牧师。

sentences.en: Wherever I have a church, all people will be welcome.
sentences.zh: 无论我在哪里拥有教堂，所有人都将受到欢迎。

sentences.en: Jones despised the hypocrisy in local churches.
sentences.zh: 琼斯鄙视当地教堂里的虚伪。

sentences.en: In one church auditorium, Jones was vocally displeased with the minister's elegant Cadillac parked out front,
sentences.zh: 在一个教堂礼拜堂里，琼斯大声表达了他对牧师停在正门前那辆豪华凯迪拉克的反感，

sentences.en: when poverty was so evident in the community, especially amongst the church's own congregation.
sentences.zh: 当时社区里的贫困是如此明显，尤其是在教堂自己的会众当中。

sentences.en: Jones reflected on his childhood and disavowed God for allowing poverty and injustice to exiSt.
sentences.zh: 琼斯回想起自己的童年，并公开否认了允许贫困和不公存在的上帝。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 引文，

sentences.en: When I was five years old, I was laying on springs with no covers, and the rain was pouring through the roof of my old ramshackle house, and they told me to pray to God.
sentences.zh: 自我五岁起，我就躺在没有被子的弹簧床上，雨水从我那破旧老房子的屋顶倾盆而下，而他们却告诉我要向上帝祈祷。

sentences.en: There was no God that came.
sentences.zh: 根本没有上帝出现。

sentences.en: The rain kept pouring.
sentences.zh: 雨还在不停地下。

sentences.en: I then had a beam of consciousness.
sentences.zh: 那时我产生了一种意识的觉醒。

sentences.en: I said there shouldn't be any poor.
sentences.zh: 我说过不应该有任何穷人。

sentences.en: There shouldn't be any private property.
sentences.zh: 不应该有任何私有财产。

sentences.en: When I looked inside of me, I found the power of socialism in me.
sentences.zh: 当我审视自己的内心时，我发现了存在于我之中的社会主义力量。

sentences.en: And I quit praying.
sentences.zh: 于是我停止了祈祷。

sentences.en: Jim Jones started attending gatherings of the Communist Party USA.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·琼斯开始参加美国共产党聚会。

sentences.en: Supporters of communism believe it leads to true equality.
sentences.zh: 共产主义的支持者相信它能带来真正的平等。

sentences.en: Critics judge communism by its failed implementation throughout history.
sentences.zh: 批评者则根据共产主义在历史上实施失败的经历来对它进行评判。

sentences.en: Whenever communism has been in effect, it has caused mass killings, crimes against humanity, suppression of human rights, and power imbalances.
sentences.zh: 每当共产主义付诸实行时，它都造成了大规模屠杀、反人类罪行、人权压制和权力失衡。

sentences.en: Communism was at the time prominent in places like China, Cuba, North Korea, Vietnam, and Russia.
sentences.zh: 当时，共产主义在中国、古巴、朝鲜、越南和俄罗斯等地非常显眼。

sentences.en: Areas that were deemed enemies or allies of the enemies of the United States.
sentences.zh: 这些地区被认为是美国的敌人或美国敌人的盟友。

sentences.en: Therefore, American communists were viewed as anti-American and traitors.
sentences.zh: 因此，美国共产党人被视为反美分子和叛徒。

sentences.en: Jim Jones considered ways he could convince American people to accept communism.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·琼斯思考着他可以如何说服美国人民接受共产主义。

sentences.en: And that's when he got his lightbulb moment.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，他灵光一现。

sentences.en: Infiltrate the church.
sentences.zh: 渗透教堂。

sentences.en: In 1954, Jones bought a small church building in Indianapolis, located in a neighbourhood that had been issued a court order to desegregate.
sentences.zh: 1954年，琼斯在印第安纳波利斯买下了一座小型教堂建筑，该建筑位于一个已被法院下令废除种族隔离的社区中。

sentences.en: He named his church Community Unity, and went door-to-door inviting members of the African-American community to the first interracial church in town.
sentences.zh: 他将自己的教堂命名为“社区团结”，并挨家挨户地邀请非裔美国人社区的成员来到镇上第一座跨种族教堂。

sentences.en: Jones boasted,
sentences.zh: 琼斯吹嘘说，

sentences.en: Our door is open so wide that all races, creeds, and colours find a hearty welcome to come in, relax, meditate, and worship God.
sentences.zh: 我们的大门敞开得如此之宽，以至于所有种族、信条和肤色的人都能受到热烈欢迎，进来放松、冥想并敬拜上帝。

sentences.en: Her childhood spent learning and replicating religious showmanship now served a purpose for Jones.
sentences.zh: 她童年时期学习和复制宗教演艺技巧的经历，如今对琼斯大有用处。

sentences.en: His sermons were filled with the same dramatic pauses, shaking hands, shouted and repeated words, and pointed fingers that featured in the sermons he witnessed as a child.
sentences.zh: 他的布道充满了与他童年时见过的布道中相同的戏剧性停顿、颤抖的手、大声喊出和重复的词语以及指指点点的手势。

sentences.en: He used the traditions of Pentecostalism to create a dynamic and engaging church experience that people would come back to.
sentences.zh: 他利用五旬节派的传统来创造一种充满活力且引人入胜的教堂体验，让人们愿意再次光临。

sentences.en: With his thick, dark hair slicked back in the hip rockabilly style reminiscent of Elvis Presley, a charming grin, a pair of aviator sunglasses that he wore even in church,
sentences.zh: 他那向后梳理、带有埃尔维斯·普雷斯利风格的时髦摇滚厚密黑发，迷人的微笑，即使在教堂里也佩戴着的飞行员太阳镜，

sentences.en: and his use of street slang,
sentences.zh: 以及他使用的街头俚语，

sentences.en: Jim Jones stood out as a modern, progressive pastor.
sentences.zh: 使吉姆·琼斯作为一位现代、进步的牧师脱颖而出。

sentences.en: His mass featured upbeat hymns, jazzy organ music, and dancing down the aisles.
sentences.zh: 他的集会以欢快的赞美诗、爵士风的风琴音乐和在过道里跳舞为特色。

sentences.en: Soon after starting his church,
sentences.zh: 在他建立教堂后不久，

sentences.en: Jim Jones witnessed a faith healing service.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·琼斯目睹了一场信仰治愈仪式。

sentences.en: Faith healing uses prayer and gestures to elicit divine intervention to cure sickness.
sentences.zh: 信仰治愈利用祈祷和手势来引发神圣干预以治愈疾病。

sentences.en: Believers claim a healer with a spiritual connection to God can heal physical ailments, paralysis, and disorders.
sentences.zh: 信徒们声称，与上帝有精神联系的治疗师可以治愈身体疾病、瘫痪和各种紊乱症。

sentences.en: Medical science considers faith healings a psychological phenomenon attributed to endorphins creating a placebo effect.
sentences.zh: 医学界认为信仰治愈是一种心理现象，归因于内啡肽产生的安慰剂效应。

sentences.en: Jones observed that faith healings attracted vulnerable, desperate people.
sentences.zh: 琼斯观察到，信仰治愈吸引了脆弱、绝望的人们。

sentences.en: These people would donate their life savings for an opportunity to heal themselves or their loved ones.
sentences.zh: 这些人会捐出他们一生的积蓄，以换取治愈自己或所爱之人的机会。

sentences.en: So Jones saw faith healings as a means to achieve his own goals.
sentences.zh: 因此，琼斯将信仰治愈视为实现自己目标的一种手段。

sentences.en: At the time, he was struggling financially.
sentences.zh: 当时，他在经济上举步维艰。

sentences.en: Marceline's full-time nursing work barely covered the essentials for their family.
sentences.zh: 玛瑟琳的全职护理工作勉强能维持他们一家的基本生活。

sentences.en: Jones realised the money he could make by performing healings could be used to propel his socialist dreams of equality into reality.
sentences.zh: 琼斯意识到，通过进行治愈表演所能赚到的钱，可以用来将他关于平等的社会主义梦想化为现实。

sentences.en: Ready to grow his congregation,
sentences.zh: 准备好壮大他的会众后，

sentences.en: 24-year-old Jim Jones was ordained as a minister.
sentences.zh: 24岁的吉姆·琼斯被按立为牧师。

sentences.en: The now-reverend organised a religious convention to take place in Indianapolis from June 11 to June 15, 1956.
sentences.zh: 这位如今的牧师组织了一场宗教大会，于1956年6月11日至6月15日在印第安纳波利斯举行。

sentences.en: To draw a crowd,
sentences.zh: 为了吸引人群，

sentences.en: Jones invited popular healing evangelist
sentences.zh: 琼斯邀请了受欢迎的治愈布道家

sentences.en: Reverend William Branham to headline the event.
sentences.zh: 威廉·布兰汉姆牧师担任活动的领衔嘉宾。

sentences.en: Afterwards,
sentences.zh: 在此之后，

sentences.en: Reverend Jim Jones went public with his own healing powers.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·琼斯牧师公开展示了他自己的治愈能力。

sentences.en: To prepare for healings,
sentences.zh: 为了准备治愈表演，

sentences.en: Jones discreetly investigated his congregation.
sentences.zh: 琼斯暗中调查了他的会众。

sentences.en: He'd eavesdrop on conversations and use overheard information during mass to assert his mind-reading powers.
sentences.zh: 他会偷听谈话，并在弥撒中使用无意中听到的信息来宣示他能读懂人心的能力。

sentences.en: During mass,
sentences.zh: 在弥撒期间，

sentences.en: Jones would call forward injured or ill people from abuse.
sentences.zh: 琼斯会把遭受虐待而受伤或生病的人叫到前面。

sentences.en: With a touch of his healing hands, he claimed to remove cataracts, cure cancers, growths and headaches, and replace broken hips.
sentences.zh: 通过他那具有治愈力的双手的抚摸，他声称能够消除白内障、治愈癌症、肿瘤和头痛，并接好断裂的臀部。

sentences.en: Jones had a group of loyal aides who disguised themselves as church visitors to spy on other guests to gather intel.
sentences.zh: 琼斯有一群忠诚的助手，他们伪装成教堂访客来监视其他客人以收集情报。

sentences.en: They'd sift through the garbage of congregation members, visit members' homes to snoop around, and call homes pretending to be conducting a survey on behalf of an agency.
sentences.zh: 他们会搜查会众成员的垃圾，拜访成员的家四处打探，并假装代表某个机构进行民意调查而拨打私人电话。

sentences.en: This allowed Jones to know the personal details about churchgoers, from what medications they were taking to what brand of mayonnaise they ate.
sentences.zh: 这使得琼斯能够了解关于教堂常客的个人详细信息，从他们正在服用什么药物到他们吃什么牌子的蛋黄酱。

sentences.en: All this data was noted on paper that Jones hid on his preacher's podium.
sentences.zh: 所有这些数据都被记在纸上，藏在琼斯的讲台下面。

sentences.en: Jones paraded meaty, foul-smelling, cancerous lumps he claimed to have removed from sick bodies.
sentences.zh: 琼斯展示了那些血淋淋、散发着恶臭的癌性肿块，他声称这些是从生病的人体中切除的。

sentences.en: Backstage, two of his aides guarded the bag of cancers where the lumps were stored.
sentences.zh: 在后台，他的两名助手看守着存放着这些肿块的装有癌症的袋子。

sentences.en: The lumps were actually chicken gizzards, but people fell for it.
sentences.zh: 这些肿块实际上是鸡胗，但人们却信以为真。

sentences.en: During one public show,
sentences.zh: 在一次公开表演中，

sentences.en: Jones ordered an elderly woman confined to a wheelchair to stand and move forward.
sentences.zh: 琼斯命令一位被限制在轮椅上的老妇人站起来并向前走动。

sentences.en: She doubted herself and shook her head.
sentences.zh: 她对自己感到怀疑并摇了摇头。

sentences.en: He told her, bless your heart and take that step.
sentences.zh: 他告诉她，愿上帝保佑你，迈出那一步。

sentences.en: She stood, shakily at firSt.
sentences.zh: 她起初颤颤巍巍地站了起来。

sentences.en: The old woman then shuffled down the rows of pews to Jones's encouragement.
sentences.zh: 然后在琼斯的鼓励下，这位老妇人在一排排长椅之间蹒跚前行。

sentences.en: Then she ran.
sentences.zh: 接着她跑了起来。

sentences.en: The crowd hooted and hollered at the miracle.
sentences.zh: 人群为这个奇迹欢呼雀跃。

sentences.en: Jones healed this woman of nothing.
sentences.zh: 琼斯并没有治愈这个女人的任何疾病。

sentences.en: She was his personal secretary and was never confined to a wheelchair.
sentences.zh: 她是他的私人秘书，从未被限制在轮椅上。

sentences.en: Throughout his life,
sentences.zh: 在他的一生中，

sentences.en: Jones performed this miraculous healing on the same woman multiple times.
sentences.zh: 琼斯多次对同一个女人执行这种奇迹般的治愈。

sentences.en: Word of the miracles performed by Jim Jones spread throughout the city and beyond.
sentences.zh: 关于吉姆·琼斯所创造奇迹的传言传遍了整个城市及更远的地方。

sentences.en: His healings were aired on television and local radio.
sentences.zh: 他的治愈表演在电视和当地广播电台上播出。

sentences.en: People arrived at Jones's church at 2pm just to get a seat for his 7.30 mass.
sentences.zh: 人们下午2点就到达琼斯的教堂，只为了能在他7点30分的弥撒中占到一个座位。

sentences.en: Others climbed through the windows of the overcrowded buildings to witness his gospel.
sentences.zh: 还有人爬过拥挤不堪的建筑物的窗户来见证他的福音。

sentences.en: His performances became so popular,
sentences.zh: 他的表演变得如此受欢迎，

sentences.en: Jones moved to a larger church building to accommodate the enormous crowd.
sentences.zh: 以至于琼斯搬到了一座更大的教堂建筑里，以容纳庞大的人群。

sentences.en: He renamed his church
sentences.zh: 他将自己的教堂更名为

sentences.en: People's Temple Full Gospel Church, commonly referred to as People's Temple.
sentences.zh: 人民圣殿全福音教堂，通常被称为人民圣殿。

sentences.en: Jones only performed healings at the end of his sermons, meaning his audience first had to sit through his speeches on improving rights for women, minorities, and the poor.
sentences.zh: 琼斯只在布道结束时才进行治愈表演，这意味着他的听众必须先听完他关于改善妇女、少数族裔和穷人权利的演讲。

sentences.en: Then came his most impressive healings yet.
sentences.zh: 接下来便是他迄今为止最令人印象深刻的治愈表演。

sentences.en: Churchgoers who defied Jim Jones or doubted his power dropped dead during mass.
sentences.zh: 那些蔑视吉姆·琼斯或怀疑其法力的信徒在弥撒期间突然倒地身亡。

sentences.en: These people weren't actors in on Jim Jones's deception.
sentences.zh: 这些人并不是吉姆·琼斯骗局里的演员。

sentences.en: They were real people who doubted him.
sentences.zh: 他们都是曾怀疑过他的真实人类。

sentences.en: Unbeknownst to everyone but Jones and his aides, each victim had been drugged with potent sedatives moments prior to their death.
sentences.zh: 除了琼斯和他的助手外，无人知晓，每名受害者在死前不久都被注射了强效镇静剂。

sentences.en: Only they didn't really die.
sentences.zh: 只不过他们并没有真正死去。

sentences.en: They only passed out.
sentences.zh: 他们只是昏厥了过去。

sentences.en: And as they came to,
sentences.zh: 当他们苏醒过来时，

sentences.en: Jones pretended he brought them back to life.
sentences.zh: 琼斯假装是自己让他们起死回生。

sentences.en: Drugs became a useful tool throughout Jim Jones's career as a healer.
sentences.zh: 在吉姆·琼斯作为“治愈者”的职业生涯中，药物成了一种有用的工具。

sentences.en: An elderly woman was drugged after one service.
sentences.zh: 一位老妇人在一次礼拜后被下了药。

sentences.en: She woke up afterwards with a cast around her leg.
sentences.zh: 她醒来后发现自己的腿上打着石膏。

sentences.en: Church staff told her she had fallen and broken it.
sentences.zh: 教会的工作人员告诉她，她摔断了腿。

sentences.en: Days later, she attended Jim Jones's mass.
sentences.zh: 几天后，她参加了吉姆·琼斯的弥撒。

sentences.en: He singled her out, placed his hands on her leg, and claimed to have healed her.
sentences.zh: 他把她叫了出来，把手放在她的腿上，并声称自己治好了她。

sentences.en: The cast was removed, and to the woman's surprise, she stood and walked without pain.
sentences.zh: 石膏被拆除了，令这位妇人惊讶的是，她站起来走路时一点也不痛。

sentences.en: It was as though her leg was never broken.
sentences.zh: 就好像她的腿从来没断过一样。

sentences.en: And that's because it wasn't.
sentences.zh: 那是因为她的腿本来就没断。

sentences.en: Once he had followers,
sentences.zh: 一旦他有了追随者，

sentences.en: Jim Jones directed attention from his healing powers towards his communist agenda.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·琼斯便将人们的注意力从他的治愈能力转移到了他的共产主义议程上。

sentences.en: Healings of individual people became less common.
sentences.zh: 对个人的治愈变得不那么常见了。

sentences.en: Instead,
sentences.zh: 取而代之的是，

sentences.en: Jones said he wanted to heal society.
sentences.zh: 琼斯表示他想要治愈整个社会。

sentences.en: He told his congregation that living a life of God required something of them.
sentences.zh: 他告诉会众，过上帝般的生活需要他们付出代价。

sentences.en: They needed to feed the hungry, take care of the sick, and donate their possessions to create economic equality.
sentences.zh: 他们需要救济饥民、照顾病人，并捐出自己的财产以实现经济平等。

sentences.en: Only then would they become more God-like.
sentences.zh: 只有那样，他们才会变得更像上帝。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 引述如下：

sentences.en: It became clear a large percentage of his audience were only interested in his healings.
sentences.zh: 很明显，他的听众中有很大一部分人只对他的治愈能力感兴趣。

sentences.en: Worshippers were hesitant to give away their possessions and live a life of charity.
sentences.zh: 信徒们很不愿交出自己的财产并过上慈善的生活。

sentences.en: They began abandoning
sentences.zh: 他们开始抛弃

sentences.en: Jim Jones's church as quickly as they joined.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·琼斯的教会，其速度正如他们加入时那样快。

sentences.en: What remained was a group of loyal devotees who wanted to go on and reach perfection by living the life
sentences.zh: 留下来的是一群忠实的信徒，他们希望通过过上

sentences.en: Jim Jones instructed of them.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·琼斯指示他们的生活，来继续前进并达到完美。

sentences.en: Marceline Jones stated that when the audience numbers dropped after the healings, quality was gained.
sentences.zh: 玛瑟琳·琼斯表示，当治愈事件后听众数量下降时，反而获得了质量。

sentences.en: People's Temple became a small, devoted church family.
sentences.zh: 人民圣殿教变成了一个小型、虔诚的教会大家庭。

sentences.en: They spoke of a bond stronger than blood.
sentences.zh: 他们谈论着一种胜过血缘的纽带。

sentences.en: However, the massive and sudden desertion hurt Jones.
sentences.zh: 然而，大规模且突然的背叛深深伤害了琼斯。

sentences.en: When it came to followers, he cared about quantity more than quality.
sentences.zh: 在追随者方面，他看重数量胜过质量。

sentences.en: A small group with little funding could not achieve his dreams of a socialist Eden.
sentences.zh: 资金匮乏的小群体无法实现他建立社会主义伊甸园的梦想。

sentences.en: Jones blamed himself.
sentences.zh: 琼斯将责任归咎于自己。

sentences.en: He had not done enough to force the disenfranchised people to stay.
sentences.zh: 他做得还不够，没能强迫这些被剥夺权利的人留下来。

sentences.en: A mistake he would never make again.
sentences.zh: 这是一个他绝不会再犯的错误。

sentences.en: Jim Jones had a vision of an explosion from a nuclear bomb so devastating it annihilated everything.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·琼斯幻想到了一场极具毁灭性的原子弹爆炸，它湮灭了一切。

sentences.en: The threat of nuclear war was very real to Americans at the time.
sentences.zh: 当时的美国人对核战争的威胁有着深刻的体会。

sentences.en: Fallout shelters were built, children were taught bomb survival drills, and people were warned to avoid looking at flashes in the sky.
sentences.zh: 防空洞被建造起来，孩子们被教导炸弹生存演习，人们被警告要避免看天空中的闪光。

sentences.en: Jones wasn't the only preacher to have a nuclear apocalypse vision of the future.
sentences.zh: 琼斯并不是唯一一个对未来有核末日幻象的传道人。

sentences.en: Many preachers used these haunting visions to pressure flocks of people back into the church.
sentences.zh: 许多传道人利用这些挥之不去的幻象，迫使成群的人回到教会。

sentences.en: Jones read an article in Esquire magazine titled
sentences.zh: 琼斯在《君子》杂志上读到了一篇文章，题为

sentences.en: Nine Places to Hide.
sentences.zh: 《九个藏身之所》。

sentences.en: The article listed locations that could survive a global nuclear war.
sentences.zh: 这篇文章列出了能够在全球核战争中幸存下来的地点。

sentences.en: The location that appealed to Jim Jones the most was Belo Horizonte in southeast Brazil.
sentences.zh: 最吸引吉姆·琼斯的地点是巴西东南部的贝洛奥里藏特。

sentences.en: Jones convinced his family to pack their belongings and travel with him to Belo Horizonte.
sentences.zh: 琼斯说服家人打包行李，与他一起前往贝洛奥里藏特。

sentences.en: He wanted to investigate the location and determine if he could relocate people's temple there.
sentences.zh: 他想实地考察这个地方，并确定是否可以把人民圣殿教迁移到那里。

sentences.en: This big move would make abandoning the church far more difficult for people's temple members in the future.
sentences.zh: 这一重大举措将使人民圣殿教成员在未来更加难以抛弃教会。

sentences.en: Life in Belo Horizonte was not ideal.
sentences.zh: 贝洛奥里藏特的生活并不理想。

sentences.en: The language difference was a problem and Jones struggled to get work and provide for his young family.
sentences.zh: 语言差异是个问题，琼斯很难找到工作来养活他年轻的家庭。

sentences.en: By mid-1963,
sentences.zh: 到1963年年中，

sentences.en: Jones flew his family to Rio de Janeiro where he got work helping people in the poverty-stricken sluMs.
sentences.zh: 琼斯带着家人飞往里约热内卢，在那里他找到了一份在贫民窟帮助穷人的工作。

sentences.en: Jones' associate preachers back in Indiana contacted him and warned him that his people's temple church was close to collapsing.
sentences.zh: 印第安纳州的琼斯的副手传道人们联系了他，并警告他说他的人民圣殿教教会已经濒临崩溃。

sentences.en: Mass services that once attracted
sentences.zh: 曾经吸引

sentences.en: 2,000 people now barely attracted 100.
sentences.zh: 2000人的大型礼拜现在勉强能吸引100人。

sentences.en: Jones felt he had abandoned his congregation and given up on the American civil rights struggle.
sentences.zh: 琼斯觉得自己抛弃了会众，放弃了美国民权斗争。

sentences.en: By December 63,
sentences.zh: 到了63年12月，

sentences.en: Jones was back in Indiana and back behind his lectern in church.
sentences.zh: 琼斯回到了印第安纳州，回到了教会的讲台后面。

sentences.en: His return reinvigorated people's temple and the empty pews began to refill.
sentences.zh: 他的回归重振了人民圣殿教，空荡荡的长椅开始重新坐满。

sentences.en: Case File will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 案卷档案稍后回归。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本期节目的赞助商来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持

sentences.en: Case File to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 案卷档案继续提供优质内容。

sentences.en: Upon Jones' return to America, swastikas were painted on the outside of his church.
sentences.zh: 在琼斯返回美国后，他的教堂外墙被画上了纳粹万字标志。

sentences.en: A stick of dynamite was left in his coal pile.
sentences.zh: 他的煤堆里被留了一根炸药。

sentences.en: A dead cat was thrown at his home.
sentences.zh: 一只死猫被扔到了他的家门口。

sentences.en: Rocks were thrown through his windows, his car tyres were slashed, and he received threatening phone calls.
sentences.zh: 他的窗户被人扔了石头，汽车轮胎被划破，他还接到了威胁电话。

sentences.en: Whilst visiting a friend,
sentences.zh: 在拜访朋友期间，

sentences.en: Jones was alone in a front room when a rock shattered the window beside him.
sentences.zh: 琼斯独自一人在前厅，一块石头击碎了他身旁的窗户。

sentences.en: He blamed the attack on racists, however the window glass shattered outwards from the inside.
sentences.zh: 他将这次袭击归咎于种族主义者，然而窗户玻璃却是从内部向外碎裂的。

sentences.en: The pile of broken shards were resting on the front lawn, not in the room.
sentences.zh: 碎玻璃堆散落在前草坪上，而不是房间里。

sentences.en: Some called into question the legitimacy of these attacks.
sentences.zh: 一些人对这些袭击的真实性提出了质疑。

sentences.en: Rumours swelled outside of the church that Jim
sentences.zh: 教会外有传言称，吉姆·

sentences.en: Jones had orchestrated some, if not all, of the attacks against him.
sentences.zh: 琼斯策划了针对他的一部分甚至全部袭击事件。

sentences.en: Inside his church,

sentences.zh: 琼斯在

sentences.en: Redwood Valley.
sentences.zh: 红wood山谷夸耀他的事工。

sentences.en: I've got acres of fields of greens and potatoes and strawberries and pear and tomatoes.
sentences.zh: 我拥有成英亩的绿叶菜、马铃薯、草莓、梨和西红柿田。

sentences.en: I've got grapes.
sentences.zh: 我有葡萄。

sentences.en: I've got the harvest on a hundred hills.
sentences.zh: 我在上百座小山上都有收成。

sentences.en: Take me up on my offer and come to
sentences.zh: 接受我的邀请，来

sentences.en: California.
sentences.zh: 加利福尼亚吧。

sentences.en: Come out there in those beautiful fields of Eden.
sentences.zh: 来到伊甸园那些美丽的田野里。

sentences.en: See what we're doing out there for freedom.
sentences.zh: 看看我们在那里为自由做些什么。

sentences.en: And I'll tell you, you won't want to come back.
sentences.zh: 我告诉你，你不会想回去了。

sentences.en: 700 temple members were crammed onto the buses to bolster Jones's campaign.
sentences.zh: 700名圣殿成员挤上了巴士，以支持琼斯的竞选活动。

sentences.en: The trips could take upwards of three weeks.
sentences.zh: 这些旅行可能需要长达三周的时间。

sentences.en: At each location, Jones stated,
sentences.zh: 在每个地方，琼斯都宣称：

sentences.en: There is indeed hope for our troubled nation.
sentences.zh: 我们饱受困扰的国家确实还有希望。

sentences.en: For in this single-spirited church, there is alive the type of dedication and commitment to brotherhood and fundamental human cooperation that may well be the
sentences.zh: 因为在这个信念单一的教会中，依然存活着一种对兄弟情谊以及基本人类合作的奉献与承诺精神，这很可能是解决我们土地上种种问题的

sentences.en: best solution to the problems that beset our land.
sentences.zh: 最佳方案。

sentences.en: This group is demonstrating what religion should be.
sentences.zh: 这个群体正在展示宗教应有的样子。

sentences.en: We would not have wars if everyone thought and lived as these people do.
sentences.zh: 如果每个人都像这些人一样思考和生活，我们就不会有战争。

sentences.en: People from all walks of life were attracted to the positive lifestyle and optimistic worldview promoted by the temple.
sentences.zh: 各行各业的人都被圣殿宣扬的积极生活方式和乐观世界观所吸引。

sentences.en: And Jones kept membership demographics balanced and equal.
sentences.zh: 而且琼斯保持了会员人口统计数据的平衡和均等。

sentences.en: To complement the large number of working class, Jones recruited younger college-educated people.
sentences.zh: 为了补充大量的工人阶级，琼斯招募了受过大学教育的年轻人。

sentences.en: To balance out the traditionally religious group he brought from the
sentences.zh: 为了平衡他从

sentences.en: Midwest, he recruited progressive atheists.
sentences.zh: 中西部带来的传统宗教群体，他招募了进步的无神论者。

sentences.en: Jones melded these separate, often conflicting groups into one cohesive group of supporters.
sentences.zh: 琼斯将这些独立的、经常发生冲突的群体融合成了一个有凝聚力的支持者群体。

sentences.en: Not under God, but under socialism.
sentences.zh: 不信仰上帝，而是信仰社会主义。

sentences.en: Homes were sold and jobs were quit.
sentences.zh: 房子卖了，工作辞了。

sentences.en: In return, the recruited were moved to
sentences.zh: 作为回报，新招募的人被转移到

sentences.en: California into temple-owned buildings.
sentences.zh: 加利福尼亚的圣殿拥有的大楼里。

sentences.en: Residents received small living quarters, communal meals, and an allowance of $5 per week for necessities.
sentences.zh: 居民获得很小的居住空间、集体餐饮，以及每周5美元用于必需品的津贴。

sentences.en: Jones also reached out to the homeless, alcoholics, sex workers, the drug-addicted, the unemployed, and to single parents.
sentences.zh: 琼斯还向无家可归者、酗酒者、性工作者、吸毒者、失业者以及单亲父母伸出援手。

sentences.en: He intentionally targeted the desperate.
sentences.zh: 他故意将绝望的人作为目标。

sentences.en: He promised to care for them, to protect them, and to cleanse their addictions.
sentences.zh: 他承诺照顾他们、保护他们并帮他们戒除毒瘾。

sentences.en: He offered them jobs, a bed, a home, and a welcoming community.
sentences.zh: 他为他们提供工作、一张床、一个家和一个欢迎他们的社区。

sentences.en: All they needed to do was get on the bus.
sentences.zh: 他们需要做的就是上车。

sentences.en: And many of them did.
sentences.zh: 许多人确实这么做了。

sentences.en: As People's Temple membership grew, so did the work.
sentences.zh: 随着人民圣殿教成员的增加，工作也随之增加。

sentences.en: By 1973, there were 2,570 People's
sentences.zh: 到1973年，全美有2570名人民

sentences.en: Temple members across America.
sentences.zh: 圣殿教成员。

sentences.en: Some members became full-time workers for the church, to help with the endless duties and chores required to maintain their growing community.
sentences.zh: 一些成员成为教会的全职工人，以协助完成维持其不断壮大的社区所需的无休止的职责和杂务。

sentences.en: It wasn't unusual for full-time temple workers to work upwards of
sentences.zh: 全职圣殿工人工作超过

sentences.en: 20 hours a day.
sentences.zh: 每天20小时并不罕见。

sentences.en: Workers compared and bragged amongst themselves over how little they slept due to their commitment to
sentences.zh: 工人们在彼此之间进行比较和吹嘘，看他们因为对

sentences.en: People's Temple.
sentences.zh: 人民圣殿教的承诺而睡眠有多少。

sentences.en: The mentality of temple workers was explained by member Hugh Forston,
sentences.zh: 圣殿工人的心态由成员休·福斯顿解释，

sentences.en: Jr.
sentences.zh: 小。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 引述：

sentences.en: Being in an environment where you are constantly up, you're constantly busy, and you're made to feel guilty if you take too many luxuries like sleeping.
sentences.zh: 身处一个让你不断处于亢奋、不断忙碌的环境中，如果你把睡觉当作太多的奢侈品，就会让你感到内疚。

sentences.en: You tend to not really think for yourself.
sentences.zh: 你往往不会真正为自己思考。

sentences.en: And I did allow Jim Jones to think for me, because I figured he had the better plan.
sentences.zh: 我确实让吉姆·琼斯替我思考，因为我觉得他有更好的计划。

sentences.en: I gave my rights up to him, as many others did.
sentences.zh: 我把我的权利交给了他，就像许多其他人一样。

sentences.en: Those who couldn't work full-time for the church were asked to donate 25% of their paychecks in an act called
sentences.zh: 那些无法为教会全职工作的人被要求捐出他们薪水的25%，作为一项名为

sentences.en: The Commitment.
sentences.zh: “承诺”的行动。

sentences.en: Church staff asked members to donate their sentimental riches such as jewellery.
sentences.zh: 教会工作人员要求成员捐赠珠宝等具有纪念意义的财富。

sentences.en: Before meetings, temple staff frisked members for valuables.
sentences.zh: 在会议开始前，圣殿工作人员会搜身检查成员的贵重物品。

sentences.en: Their shoes were even emptied in case they tried to hide anything.
sentences.zh: 他们的鞋子甚至会被倒空，以防他们试图藏匿任何东西。

sentences.en: The money collections taken from the congregation during mass reached several thousand dollars per week.
sentences.zh: 弥撒期间从会众那里收取的金钱捐款达到每周数千美元。

sentences.en: But Jones deceived his followers and told them the total of their offerings was much less.
sentences.zh: 但琼斯欺骗了他的追随者，告诉他们奉献的总额要少得多。

sentences.en: This encouraged more donations.
sentences.zh: 这鼓励了更多的捐款。

sentences.en: He took checks from the county to help those in his care, but he only offered those people canned foods and second-hand clothes in return.
sentences.zh: 他拿取县里的支票来帮助那些在他照顾下的人，但他作为回报只给那些人提供罐头食品和二手衣服。

sentences.en: Thirty homes belonging to temple members were signed over to the church, who sold the properties and kept the profit.
sentences.zh: 属于圣殿成员的三十所房屋被转让给教会，教会出售了这些房产并保留了利润。

sentences.en: The profit was recorded as gifts.
sentences.zh: 收益被记录为礼金。

sentences.en: Jones was earning around $20,000 per week.
sentences.zh: 琼斯每周的收入大约在2万美元左右。

sentences.en: The excessive amounts of money and profit the church accumulated was kept hidden in various bank accounts, maintained by the church's financial and legal teaMs.
sentences.zh: 教会积累的大量资金和利润被隐藏在各种银行账户中，由教会的财务和法律团队进行维护。

sentences.en: To justify constantly asking temple members for money, Jones explained that he was planning to build them a commune, somewhere they could all go
sentences.zh: 为了证明不断向圣殿成员索要钱财是合理的，琼斯解释说他正计划为他们建造一个公社，一个他们所有人都可以去的地方

sentences.en: where fascists couldn't destroy them.
sentences.zh: 在那里法西斯分子无法摧毁他们。

sentences.en: Of the growing community, 100 long-standing people's temple members were chosen to form the Planning
sentences.zh: 在这个不断增长的社群中，100名资深人民圣殿堂成员被挑选出来组成规划

sentences.en: Commission.
sentences.zh: 委员会。

sentences.en: The majority of those chosen were young, attractive, white females.
sentences.zh: 被选中者大多是年轻、迷人的白人女性。

sentences.en: The temple and its members were run under their leadership, but Jim Jones retained final decision-making authority.
sentences.zh: 圣殿及其成员在她们的领导下运作，但吉姆·琼斯保留了最终的决策权。

sentences.en: David Parker Wise was a pastor and long-term friend of Jim Jones.
sentences.zh: 大卫·帕克·怀斯是吉姆·琼斯的一名牧师兼长期朋友。

sentences.en: He was offered a position on the
sentences.zh: 他被提供了一个进入

sentences.en: Planning Commission.
sentences.zh: 规划委员会的职位。

sentences.en: David recalled, quote,
sentences.zh: 大卫回忆说，原话是：

sentences.en: The great respect that I had from the other inner staff ended later when I was asked to join the Planning
sentences.zh: 我对其他核心员工的高度尊重后来在我被邀请加入规划

sentences.en: Commission, which ruined everything.
sentences.zh: 委员会时结束了，这毁了一切。

sentences.en: Jim told me that the Planning
sentences.zh: 吉姆告诉我，规划

sentences.en: Commission could learn from my great honesty.
sentences.zh: 委员会可以从我极大的诚实中学习。

sentences.en: However, I learned that honesty was not really welcome.
sentences.zh: 然而，我了解到诚实并不真的受欢迎。

sentences.en: I was expected to be an attack dog, or to be attacked myself, and decided not to play ball.
sentences.zh: 人们期望我成为一条攻击犬，或者自己遭到攻击，而我决定不予配合。

sentences.en: As a result, Jim and I became more alienated from each other, and he began to perceive me as a threat.
sentences.zh: 结果，吉姆和我变得越来越疏远，他开始将我视为一种威胁。

sentences.en: Frankly, I thought his behavior in the
sentences.zh: 坦白说，我认为他在

sentences.en: Planning Commission was insane and absurd.
sentences.zh: 规划委员会里的行为既疯狂又荒谬。

sentences.en: I was especially worried that he contradicted himself all the time.
sentences.zh: 我尤其担心他总是自相矛盾。

sentences.en: It was around that time that I found amphetamines in his pill bag.
sentences.zh: 大约就在那时，我在他的药包里发现了苯丙胺。

sentences.en: To keep himself awake, alert, and energized, Jones was secretly taking amphetamines.
sentences.zh: 为了保持清醒、机敏和精力充沛，琼斯在暗中服用苯丙胺。

sentences.en: This prolonged and frequent drug consumption amplified Jones' paranoia.
sentences.zh: 这种长期且频繁的药物滥用加剧了琼斯的偏执。

sentences.en: He began rambling about enemies who were after him.
sentences.zh: 他开始语无伦次地谈论那些追踪他的敌人。

sentences.en: On one Sunday afternoon, whilst the congregation milled about in the church's parking lot, they heard the swift crack of gunfire.
sentences.zh: 在一个星期天的下午，当信众们在教会的停车场闲逛时，他们听到了清脆的枪声。

sentences.en: Panicked, they looked to their leader.
sentences.zh: 惊慌失措之下，他们望向他们的领袖。

sentences.en: Blooming from the center of Jones' shirt was a large, soggy red stain.
sentences.zh: 在琼斯衬衫的正中央，绽开了一大片湿漉漉的红色污渍。

sentences.en: Jones clutched his chest and fell.
sentences.zh: 琼斯捂住胸口倒了下去。

sentences.en: His aides quickly lifted his limp body into the church.
sentences.zh: 他的助手们迅速将他瘫软的身体抬进了教堂。

sentences.en: Fear gripped the congregation.
sentences.zh: 恐惧攫住了信众。

sentences.en: They believed Jim Jones had been assassinated.
sentences.zh: 他们相信吉姆·琼斯遭到暗杀了。

sentences.en: Half an hour later, the doors to the church opened.
sentences.zh: 半小时后，教堂的大门打开了。

sentences.en: Their leader emerged, wearing a new shirt.
sentences.zh: 他们的领袖走了出来，换上了一件新衬衫。

sentences.en: Jones explained he had healed his bullet wound, and the crowd cheered.
sentences.zh: 琼斯解释说他已经治愈了自己的枪伤，人群欢呼雀跃。

sentences.en: The bloody shirt was hung in the church as a reminder to followers that
sentences.zh: 那件带血的衬衫被挂在教堂里，提醒追随者们

sentences.en: Jim Jones was in constant danger.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·琼斯处于危险之中。

sentences.en: Members chose not to question why there wasn't a bullet hole through the fabric.
sentences.zh: 成员们选择不去质疑为什么织物上没有弹孔。

sentences.en: Attacks on Jim Jones and his temple became regular occurrences.
sentences.zh: 针对吉姆·琼斯及其圣殿的袭击成了家常便饭。

sentences.en: Molotov cocktails were thrown at church property.
sentences.zh: 燃烧弹被扔向教会财产。

sentences.en: Dead animals were left on front lawns.
sentences.zh: 死去的动物被丢在前草坪上。

sentences.en: Jones found broken glass in his food.
sentences.zh: 琼斯在食物里发现了碎玻璃。

sentences.en: Sniper dots constantly tracked him.
sentences.zh: 狙击瞄准红点不断追踪着他。

sentences.en: A bomb was found under his bus.
sentences.zh: 他的巴士下发现了一枚炸弹。

sentences.en: And a needle filled with poison was hidden in his folded underwear.
sentences.zh: 他的折叠内裤里藏着一根装满毒药的针。

sentences.en: Like his faith healings, these dramatic events were orchestrated by Jones to trick his followers.
sentences.zh: 就像他的信仰疗法一样，这些戏剧性的事件都是琼斯为欺骗信徒而精心策划的。

sentences.en: He perpetrated the fear by surrounding himself with armed bodyguards and by making his vehicles bulletproof.
sentences.zh: 他通过让武装保镖环绕四周以及将车辆改装成防弹车来制造恐惧。

sentences.en: Guards stood at the entrance to the church and questioned and searched everyone who entered.
sentences.zh: 警卫站在教堂入口处，盘问和搜查每一个进入的人。

sentences.en: Familiar faces and strangers alike.
sentences.zh: 无论是熟面孔还是陌生人。

sentences.en: Some guards carried guns.
sentences.zh: 一些警卫携带枪支。

sentences.en: Why are you here, they would ask visitors suspiciously.
sentences.zh: 他们会带着怀疑的语气问访客，你来这里干什么？

sentences.en: What do you think about Jim Jones?
sentences.zh: 你怎么看吉姆·琼斯？

sentences.en: Fear of outside enemies embedded itself deep within temple membership, and temple members became fiercely defensive and loyal towards their church and
sentences.zh: 对外在敌人的恐惧深深植入了圣殿成员的心中，圣殿成员对他们的教会和

sentences.en: leader, which is exactly what Jim
sentences.zh: 领袖变得极具防御性和忠诚度，这正是吉姆

sentences.en: Jones had intended.
sentences.zh: 琼斯所期望的。

sentences.en: Outside the church, Jones's paranoia, attention-seeking, and fear of rejection manifested in bizarre behavior around his family.
sentences.zh: 在教堂之外，琼斯的偏执、寻求关注以及对被拒绝的恐惧在他的家庭周围表现为怪异的行为。

sentences.en: Jones would feign sickness that would cultivate in dramatic scenes.
sentences.zh: 琼斯会假装生病，从而引发戏剧性的场面。

sentences.en: He'd collapse, grasp his chest, wheeze for air, and choke on words.
sentences.zh: 他会瘫倒，抓着胸口，呼哧呼哧地喘气，说话噎住。

sentences.en: Moments later, once everyone was worrying over him, it seemed perfectly fine.
sentences.zh: 片刻之后，一旦所有人都为他担心，他又看起来完全正常了。

sentences.en: His son, Stephen Jones, would later look back on his father's behavior.
sentences.zh: 他的儿子斯蒂芬·琼斯后来回忆起他父亲的行为。

sentences.en: Quote, It was losing its luster.
sentences.zh: 原话是，这正在失去光彩。

sentences.en: It seemed like we were always fearing for our lives, or his, or both.
sentences.zh: 感觉我们总是生活在对我们自己、对他、或者对两个人的生命的恐惧中。

sentences.en: And I was growing tired of it.
sentences.zh: 而我对此越来越厌倦了。

sentences.en: Inside the church, Jones's controlling behavior manifested in other ways.
sentences.zh: 在教堂内部，琼斯的控制欲以其他方式表现出来。

sentences.en: Still harboring bitterness for those church members who had abandoned him in the past, Jones came up with some nefarious ways to ensure his new followers could never leave him.
sentences.zh: 由于对过去抛弃过他的那些教会成员仍然怀恨在心，琼斯想出了一些邪恶的方法来确保他的新追随者永远无法离开他。

sentences.en: Temple members older than 11 years old were made to sign the bottom of a blank piece of paper, referred to as an attendance sheet.
sentences.zh: 11岁以上的圣殿成员被迫在被称为出席表的空白纸张底部签名。

sentences.en: If members were to leave or threaten the temple, a damaging message could be typed on the blank page above the signature.
sentences.zh: 如果成员们离开或威胁圣殿，就可以在签名上方的空白页上打印出破坏性的信息。

sentences.en: A false confession, incriminating statements, suicide notes, threats, or power of attorney.
sentences.zh: 虚假的自白、 incriminating 的陈述、遗书、威胁或授权委托书。

sentences.en: Their signatures, and the fear of what he could do with them, bound members to
sentences.zh: 他们的签名，以及对他能用这些签名做什么的恐惧，将成员们无限期地绑定在

sentences.en: Jim Jones indefinitely.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·琼斯身边。

sentences.en: During temple meetings, the planning commission handed out pens and paper and told members to write down confessions to imaginary crimes.
sentences.zh: 在圣殿会议期间，规划委员会分发纸笔，并告诉成员写下对虚构罪行的自白。

sentences.en: These pages of false confessions to murder, terrorism, rape, molestation, theft, and fraud were kept by Jones to further ensure allegiance.
sentences.zh: 这些关于谋杀、恐怖主义、强奸、猥亵、盗窃和欺诈的虚假自白书被琼斯保留下来，以进一步确保效忠。

sentences.en: At other meetings, members were told to write what they would do to people who might hurt the cause or hurt Jim
sentences.zh: 在其他会议上，成员们被要求写下他们会对那些可能伤害事业或伤害吉姆

sentences.en: Jones.
sentences.zh: 琼斯的人做些什么。

sentences.en: Explicit and violent details were encouraged.
sentences.zh: 明确和暴力的细节受到鼓励。

sentences.en: Despite objections, members were forced to write that they would kill anyone who harmed their movement.
sentences.zh: 尽管遭到反对，成员们还是被迫写下他们会杀死任何伤害他们运动的人。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 档案室稍后会回来。
