sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的赞助商以支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持

sentences.en: Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 档案室继续提供优质内容。

sentences.en: Temple members were encouraged to spy on one another and were rewarded for doing so.
sentences.zh: 圣殿成员被鼓励互相监视并因这样做而受到奖励。

sentences.en: Anyone heard talking negatively about
sentences.zh: 任何被听到说

sentences.en: Jones or making plans to leave the church were reprimanded.
sentences.zh: 琼斯坏话或密谋离开教会的人都会受到申斥。

sentences.en: It seemed impossible for temple members to willingly leave.
sentences.zh: 圣殿成员似乎不可能自愿离开。

sentences.en: They were committed financially.
sentences.zh: 他们在经济上被套牢了。

sentences.en: Homes, stocks, and belongings had been sold and paychecks handed over.
sentences.zh: 房屋、股票和财产都已被变卖，薪水也交了出去。

sentences.en: Socially, they were also committed.
sentences.zh: 在社交方面，他们也被套牢了。

sentences.en: Their friends and family were members and most wouldn't consider abandoning their loved ones.
sentences.zh: 他们的朋友和家人都是成员，大多数人不会考虑抛弃他们的挚爱。

sentences.en: The implicating false documents they all signed also kept them bound within the church.
sentences.zh: 他们都签署了的那些暗示性的虚假文件也让他们被束缚在教会内部。

sentences.en: With the fear of not knowing who to trust, as even friends and family members were turning each other in, escape couldn't be planned without Jim
sentences.zh: 由于害怕不知道该信任谁，因为连朋友和家人都在互相举报，如果不让吉姆

sentences.en: Jones finding out.
sentences.zh: 琼斯发现，根本无法策划逃跑。

sentences.en: Jones himself would often say, you cannot escape this movement.
sentences.zh: 琼斯本人经常说，你无法逃离这场运动。

sentences.en: It was the cause that motivated people's temple members.
sentences.zh: 正是这种事业激励着人民圣殿堂的成员。

sentences.en: They all still believed in doing good work and helping others to bring about equality.
sentences.zh: 他们所有人仍然相信做善事和帮助他人以实现平等。

sentences.en: But with Jim Jones's overly paranoid and controlling behaviour, the church lost its enthusiastic and contagious joy that once made it so intoxicating.
sentences.zh: 但由于吉姆·琼斯过度偏执和控制欲强的行为，教会失去了曾经使其如此迷人的热情和具有感染力的快乐。

sentences.en: To further compel members to stay in the church, families were divided.
sentences.zh: 为了进一步强迫成员留在教会，家庭被分裂了。

sentences.en: Couples, parents, children, siblings, and relatives were intentionally separated amongst temple locations.
sentences.zh: 伴侣、父母、孩子、兄弟姐妹和亲戚被故意分散在不同的圣殿地点。

sentences.en: For Jim Jones, breaking up traditional nuclear families was key to maintaining control of individuals.
sentences.zh: 对吉姆·琼斯来说，打破传统的核心家庭是保持对个人控制的关键。

sentences.en: He didn't want groups of people to have loyal ties to each other.
sentences.zh: 他不希望群体之间有彼此忠诚的纽带。

sentences.en: Just to him.
sentences.zh: 只对他忠诚。

sentences.en: Parental authority was given to the planning commission, as most children did not reside in the same building as their parents.
sentences.zh: 父母的权威被交给了规划委员会，因为大多数孩子并不与父母住在同一栋建筑里。

sentences.en: The church community raised children.
sentences.zh: 教会社群抚养了孩子们。

sentences.en: Members were ordered to divorce partners that refused to join the temple.
sentences.zh: 成员被命令与拒绝加入圣殿的伴侣离婚。

sentences.en: The relationship committee took control of intimate relationships by pairing off, permitting affairs, and marrying couples of their choosing, and forcing other couples to break up.
sentences.zh: 关系委员会通过撮合、允许出轨、将他们选择的伴侣凑成对以及强迫其他伴侣分手来控制亲密关系。

sentences.en: Throughout the 1960s, there was a sense of optimism amongst US citizens who believed change could occur through social movements.
sentences.zh: 在整个20世纪60年代，美国公民中存在一种乐观情绪，他们相信可以通过社会运动实现变革。

sentences.en: Anti-Vietnam War protests, the sexual revolution, the civil rights movement, second wave feminism, and gay rights were movements that gave power to the people.
sentences.zh: 反越战抗议、性革命、民权运动、第二波女权主义和同性恋权利运动是将权力交还给人民的运动。

sentences.en: People's Temple had spent five years in
sentences.zh: 人民圣殿堂在

sentences.en: Redwood Valley before Jim Jones moved the temple's headquarters to San Francisco in
sentences.zh: 雷德伍德谷度过了五年，之后吉姆·琼斯于1970年将圣殿总部迁至
旧金山。

sentences.en: San Francisco was the center for activist movements at the time.
sentences.zh: 旧金山当时是激进主义运动的中心。

sentences.en: People's Temple was unnoticed in the rural hills of Redwood Valley.
sentences.zh: 人民圣殿堂在雷德伍德谷的乡村山区默默无闻。

sentences.en: So Jones decided to head into the heart of a major political city, to propel and promote his socialist movement.
sentences.zh: 因此琼斯决定前往一个主要政治城市的心脏地带，以推进和宣传他的社会主义运动。

sentences.en: In San Francisco, People's Temple purchased a narrow, multi-story building as their new headquarters.
sentences.zh: 在旧金山，人民圣殿堂购买了一栋狭窄的多层建筑作为他们的新总部。

sentences.en: Jones and his family lived in an apartment on the third floor.
sentences.zh: 琼斯和他的家人住在三楼的一套公寓里。

sentences.en: Temple members lived in shed cubicles on the floors above.
sentences.zh: 圣殿成员住在楼上楼层的简易隔间里。

sentences.en: When these became overcrowded, members slept in the sanctuary downstairs where sermons and meetings were held.
sentences.zh: 当这些地方变得过于拥挤时，成员们就会睡在楼下的圣堂里，那里是举行布道和会议的地方。

sentences.en: Multiple apartment buildings were purchased around the headquarters to house more members.
sentences.zh: 总部周围购买了多栋公寓楼以容纳更多成员。

sentences.en: It was rare to find a temple member living outside of the communes.
sentences.zh: 在公社外面找到一个圣殿成员是罕见的。

sentences.en: Life in San Francisco was rough for temple members.
sentences.zh: 圣殿成员在旧金山的生活很艰难。

sentences.en: Members' pets were killed and buried in mass graves, as there wasn't enough space for them to live in the communes.
sentences.zh: 成员们的宠物被杀死并埋在万人坑里，因为没有足够的空间让它们在公社里生活。

sentences.en: The church also tightened internal budgets.
sentences.zh: 教会还收紧了内部预算。

sentences.en: Low-nutrition, mass-produced, cheap meals were always on the menu.
sentences.zh: 营养低下、批量生产的廉价餐食总是出现在菜单上。

sentences.en: Often, members were served the same bland meal throughout the day.
sentences.zh: 通常情况下，成员们一整天都被提供同样的清淡餐食。

sentences.en: Complaints were rarely aired, in fear of being labelled selfish.
sentences.zh: 抱怨很少被公开，因为害怕被贴上自私的标签。

sentences.en: Armed guards were placed out the front of the San Francisco People's Temple headquarters.
sentences.zh: 旧金山人民圣殿堂总部正门外部署了武装警卫。

sentences.en: The front door was kept locked, and only those with express permission from temple staff could enter and leave.
sentences.zh: 前门一直锁着，只有获得圣殿员工明确许可的人才能进出。

sentences.en: Written communication to outsiders was heavily inspected, scrutinised, and censored by temple staff.
sentences.zh: 与外界的书面通讯受到圣殿员工的严格检查、审查和过滤。

sentences.en: And only positive statements about the church and Jim Jones were released.
sentences.zh: 并且只发布关于教会和吉姆·琼斯的正面言论。

sentences.en: Within San Francisco, Jones worked to have
sentences.zh: 在旧金山内部，琼斯努力使

sentences.en: People's Temple become politically influential.
sentences.zh: 人民圣殿堂在政治上具有影响力。

sentences.en: Members were used to bolster campaign crowds for politicians who were friends with Jones.
sentences.zh: 成员们被用来为与琼斯是朋友的政客拉拢竞选人群。

sentences.en: Jones ordered temple members to support politicians who worked for the temple's interests.
sentences.zh: 琼斯命令圣殿成员支持为圣殿利益工作的政客。

sentences.en: To outsiders, it appeared these politicians had massive support from a diverse section of the community.
sentences.zh: 对外人来说，这些政客似乎得到了来自社区各阶层的巨大支持。

sentences.en: People's Temple members were tailor-made for political rallies due to the variety of cultures, genders, ages, and skin tones.
sentences.zh: 由于文化、性别、年龄和肤色各异，人民圣殿堂成员是政治集会的理想人选。

sentences.en: Without Jim Jones, these political rallies would have nowhere near the amount of supporters, and at the time, it was understood that it was impossible to win
sentences.zh: 如果没有吉姆·琼斯，这些政治集会将远远没有这么多的支持者，而且在当时，人们认为如果没有琼斯和人民圣殿堂的支持，就不可能在

sentences.en: office in San Francisco without the support of Jones and People's Temple.
sentences.zh: 旧金山赢得公职。

sentences.en: To outsiders, Reverend Jim Jones was the epitome of a selfless Christian.
sentences.zh: 对外人来说，吉姆·琼斯牧师是无私基督徒的化身。

sentences.en: He was seen as down-to-earth, witty, and effective.
sentences.zh: 他被视为务实、风趣且高效。

sentences.en: He was highly respected and admired for his boldness to take on injustice and corruption.
sentences.zh: 他因敢于承担不公正和腐败而受到高度尊重和敬佩。

sentences.en: In 1975, Reverend Jim Jones was named one of the most influential clergymen in the country.
sentences.zh: 1975年，吉姆·琼斯牧师被评为全国最具影响力的神职人员之一。

sentences.en: In 1976, he received the Los Angeles
sentences.zh: 1976年，他获得了洛杉矶

sentences.en: Herald's Humanitarian of the Year Award.
sentences.zh: 先驱报的人道主义年度奖。

sentences.en: One newsman said of Jones, quote,
sentences.zh: 一位新闻记者这样评价琼斯，原话是：

sentences.en: You are truly an affirmation of all that is best in the human race.
sentences.zh: 你真正肯定了人类种族中所有最美好的事物。

sentences.en: Jones concealed the truth that the social gospel principles he preached were actually the principles of communism.
sentences.zh: 琼斯隐瞒了这样一个事实：他所宣扬的社会福音原则实际上就是共产主义原则。

sentences.en: Jones blended religion and socialism for years to ensure the progression from one to the other seemed natural to his congregation.
sentences.zh: 琼斯多年来将宗教和社会主义融为一体，以确保从一种向另一种的过渡对他的会众来说显得自然。

sentences.en: He told his followers,
sentences.zh: 他告诉他的信徒们：

sentences.en: If you're born in the capitalist America, racist America, fascist America, then you're born in sin.
sentences.zh: 如果你出生在资本主义的美国、种族主义的美国、法西斯主义的美国，那你就是生于罪恶之中。

sentences.en: But if you're born in socialism, you are not born in sin.
sentences.zh: 但如果你出生在社会主义，你就不是生于罪恶之中。

sentences.en: The Bible served no function in his long-term socialist goals and he wanted his religious followers to give up on God.
sentences.zh: 圣经在他的长期社会主义目标中没有任何作用，他希望他的宗教追随者放弃上帝。

sentences.en: He said,
sentences.zh: 他说：

sentences.en: Those who remained drugged with the opiate of religion had to be brought to enlightenment.
sentences.zh: 那些仍然被宗教这个麻醉剂麻痹的人，必须被引导走向启蒙。

sentences.en: Socialism.
sentences.zh: 社会主义。

sentences.en: Church meetings became intensely anti-Bible.
sentences.zh: 教堂会议变得具有强烈的反圣经倾向。

sentences.en: Jones called Christianity a flyaway religion and labelled the Bible a tool used to oppress.
sentences.zh: 琼斯称基督教为一种逃避现实的宗教，并给圣经贴上了用于压迫的工具的标签。

sentences.en: He denounced the sky god.
sentences.zh: 他公开谴责天空之神。

sentences.en: In one sermon, he said,
sentences.zh: 在一次布道中，他说：

sentences.en: You're going to help yourself or you'll get no help.
sentences.zh: 你要么自救，要么得不到任何帮助。

sentences.en: There's only one hope of glory that's within you.
sentences.zh: 在你体内只有唯一一个荣耀的希望。

sentences.en: Nobody's going to come out of the sky.
sentences.zh: 没有人会从天而降。

sentences.en: There's no heaven up there.
sentences.zh: 那上面没有天堂。

sentences.en: We'll have to make heaven down here.
sentences.zh: 我们必须在这里创造天堂。

sentences.en: People are not saved through reading the
sentences.zh: 人们并不是通过阅读

sentences.en: Bible.
sentences.zh: 圣经来获得拯救的。

sentences.en: Networks refused to air Jones's controversial anti-Bible sermons.
sentences.zh: 各大电视网拒绝播映琼斯那些有争议的反圣经布道。

sentences.en: Proud religious people began a campaign of harassment targeted at Jones's family.
sentences.zh: 骄傲的宗教人士发起了一场针对琼斯家人的骚扰运动。

sentences.en: Jones didn't stand down.
sentences.zh: 琼斯没有退缩。

sentences.en: He continued his crusade to discredit the
sentences.zh: 他继续他那诋毁

sentences.en: Bible.
sentences.zh: 圣经的十字军东征。

sentences.en: During one mass, he accused his Christian members of being hung up on the Bible.
sentences.zh: 在一次大型聚会中，他指责他的基督徒成员对圣经执迷不悟。

sentences.en: He explained the book had held down black people for the last 200 years and he would show them it had no power.
sentences.zh: 他解释说这本书在过去200年里一直压迫着黑人，他要向他们证明这本书毫无力量。

sentences.en: He threw the Bible across the church.
sentences.zh: 他把圣经扔过了教堂。

sentences.en: The thump when it hit the wooden floor echoed up into the tall, hollow roof.
sentences.zh: 圣经砸在木地板上的闷响在高挑空旷的屋顶里回荡。

sentences.en: Jones looked back and forth at his shocked audience.
sentences.zh: 琼斯来回看着他那震惊的听众。

sentences.en: Now, he said, did you see any lightning come out of the sky and strike me dead?
sentences.zh: 现在，他说，你们看到有闪电从天而降把我劈死吗？

sentences.en: Like Father Divine before him, Jones referred to himself as God.
sentences.zh: 就像他之前的“神圣之父”一样，琼斯把自己称为上帝。

sentences.en: He began a sermon saying, for some unexplained set of reasons, I happen to be selected to be God.
sentences.zh: 他开始了一场布道，说道，由于某种说不清的原因，我恰好被选中成为上帝。

sentences.en: And, you may not believe it, but I'll tell you, there was never a miracle done in the world lest I did it.
sentences.zh: 而且，你们可能不信，但我告诉你们，世上从未发生过任何奇迹，除非是我创造的。

sentences.en: I am the God Messiah.
sentences.zh: 我是上帝弥赛亚。

sentences.en: In 1973, eight college students left
sentences.zh: 1973年，八名大学生离开了

sentences.en: People's Temple.
sentences.zh: 人民圣殿教。

sentences.en: They were the children of original Indiana
sentences.zh: 他们是印第安纳州最早的

sentences.en: People's Temple members and were considered by Jones as his best and brighteSt.
sentences.zh: 人民圣殿教成员的孩子，被琼斯视为他最优秀、最聪明的人。

sentences.en: They didn't trust anyone else and only spoke to each other about their plan to escape.
sentences.zh: 他们不信任任何人，只彼此谈论他们的逃跑计划。

sentences.en: They didn't even tell their families, as they felt they would fight them and try and make them stay.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至没有告诉家人，因为他们觉得家人会反对他们并试图让他们留下来。

sentences.en: They came to be known as the Eight
sentences.zh: 他们后来被称为八位

sentences.en: Revolutionaries, or the Gang of Eight.
sentences.zh: 革命者，或八人帮。

sentences.en: The Gang of Eight had every reason to be concerned.
sentences.zh: 八人帮完全有理由感到担忧。

sentences.en: One of them said, quote,
sentences.zh: 其中一人说，原话是：

sentences.en: At one point, we had been told that any college student who was going to leave the church would be killed, not by Jones, but by some of his followers.
sentences.zh: 有一次，我们被告知任何要离开教会的大学生都会被杀，不是被琼斯杀死，而是被他的一些追随者杀死。

sentences.en: In a letter to Jones, the Gang of Eight explained the reasons for their abandonment.
sentences.zh: 在写给琼斯的一封信中，八人帮解释了他们离开的原因。

sentences.en: They detailed the hypocrisy rampant in
sentences.zh: 他们详细描述了

sentences.en: Temple's staff.
sentences.zh: 圣殿教工作人员中横行的虚伪。

sentences.en: Jim Jones demanded celibacy, but his inner circle had sexual affairs with each other.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·琼斯要求独身，但他的核心圈子却互相发生性关系。

sentences.en: Jones preached racial equality, but the church leadership was predominantly white.
sentences.zh: 琼斯宣扬种族平等，但教会领导层主要由白人组成。

sentences.en: Money doesn't exist in a socialist society, but rich Temple members were propelled into positions of power.
sentences.zh: 社会主义社会中不存在金钱，但富有的圣殿教成员却被推上了权力位置。

sentences.en: They complained that Temple staff had become more concerned with castrating members than about working on advancing the socialist movement.
sentences.zh: 他们抱怨说，圣殿教工作人员现在更关心的是阉割成员，而不是致力于推进社会主义运动。

sentences.en: When Jim Jones read the letter, he didn't care for its contents.
sentences.zh: 当吉姆·琼斯读到这封信时，他根本不在乎信的内容。

sentences.en: He was just furious that despite all his tricks and traps, people had abandoned him yet again.
sentences.zh: 他只是愤怒于尽管他耍了那么多花招和陷阱，人们竟然还是抛弃了他。

sentences.en: A threatening campaign to harass the Gang of
sentences.zh: 一场针对八人帮的骚扰威胁运动

sentences.en: Eight began.
sentences.zh: 开始了。

sentences.en: Notes made out of chopped newspaper lettering were sent to them.
sentences.zh: 用剪碎的报纸拼凑出来的信件被寄给了他们。

sentences.en: The pages were smeared with poison oak to irritate the skin of the unsuspecting handlers.
sentences.zh: 信纸上涂满了毒漆树的汁液，以刺激不知情的经手人的皮肤。

sentences.en: We know where you live, the letters read.
sentences.zh: 信上写着，我们知道你们住在哪里。

sentences.en: We're watching you all the time.
sentences.zh: 我们一直在监视你们。

sentences.en: Keep your ass clean and your mouth clamped up.
sentences.zh: 管好你们的屁股，闭紧你们的嘴。

sentences.en: No pigs.
sentences.zh: 不准废话。

sentences.en: The Gang of Eight were bombarded with untraceable threatening phone calls.
sentences.zh: 八人帮遭到无法追查的威胁电话轰炸。

sentences.en: Obituaries were written in newspapers under their names.
sentences.zh: 报纸上以他们的名义刊登了讣告。

sentences.en: Rented hearses were left idle in front of their homes.
sentences.zh: 租来的灵车空转着停在他们家门前。

sentences.en: These actions were enough to keep the defectors silent.
sentences.zh: 这些行动足以让这些叛逃者保持沉默。

sentences.en: After the Gang of Eight left, life changed in People's Temple.
sentences.zh: 八人帮离开后，人民圣殿教的生活发生了变化。

sentences.en: Jones said,
sentences.zh: 琼斯说：

sentences.en: My love isn't working.
sentences.zh: 我的爱不管用了。

sentences.en: I guess I'll have to start getting hard on people.
sentences.zh: 我想我得开始对人们严厉一点了。

sentences.en: They seemed to respond to it better.
sentences.zh: 他们似乎对这种方式反应更好。

sentences.en: Up until this point, correcting negative behaviour within the church involved private meetings with troublesome members.
sentences.zh: 在此之前，纠正教会内部的消极行为包括与有问题的成员进行私人会面。

sentences.en: They were counselled, offered self-criticism and gently reprimanded.
sentences.zh: 他们会接受辅导、进行自我批评并受到温和的训诫。

sentences.en: But that all changed once people started defecting.
sentences.zh: 但自从人们开始叛逃后，这一切都变了。

sentences.en: Jones started calling forth troublemakers from the crowd to get up on stage.
sentences.zh: 琼斯开始把惹麻烦的人从人群中叫上台。

sentences.en: He would speak highly of the individual before cutting the flattery with a harsh statement.
sentences.zh: 他会高度赞扬这个人，随后用一句严厉的话语打破这些奉承。

sentences.en: Whether caught committing a defined crime such as smoking or a less tangible crime such as being selfish, all punishments were equal.
sentences.zh: 无论是被抓到犯下抽烟等明确的罪行，还是自私等不太具体的罪行，所有的惩罚都是一样的。

sentences.en: Hundreds of Temple members would berate and shame the troublemaker on stage and these verbal attacks became more menacing over time.
sentences.zh: 数百名圣殿教成员会在台上斥责和羞辱这个惹麻烦的人，随着时间的推移，这些言语攻击变得越来越具有威胁性。

sentences.en: They were loud, threatening and personal.
sentences.zh: 它们声音洪亮、充满威胁且极具个人针对性。

sentences.en: The victim stood silent before the crowd which usually contained their friends and families who would join in on the vicious verbal assault.
sentences.zh: 受害者静静地站在人群面前，台下通常坐着他们的朋友和家人，他们也会加入恶毒的言语攻击中。

sentences.en: This disciplinary process was labelled catharsis.
sentences.zh: 这种纪律处分程序被称为净化宣泄。

sentences.en: Temple leadership stated it re-educated the self-centred, elitist and capitalist
sentences.zh: 圣殿教领导层表示，它对自我中心、精英主义和资本主义的

sentences.en: Temple members and turned them into selfless, autonomous communists.
sentences.zh: 圣殿教成员进行了再教育，将他们变成了无私、自主的共产主义者。

sentences.en: One night, as a transgressor stood before the crowd for their catharsis,
sentences.zh: 一天晚上，当一个违规者站在人群前接受净化宣泄时，

sentences.en: Jim Jones changed things again.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·琼斯再次改变了规则。

sentences.en: He silenced the congregation, asked for a belt and then whipped the victim with it.
sentences.zh: 他让会众安静下来，要来一条皮带，然后用皮带抽打受害者。

sentences.en: Once Jones introduced physical punishments to catharsis, they eventually became normal.
sentences.zh: 一旦琼斯将体罚引入净化宣泄中，它们最终就成了家常便饭。

sentences.en: Victims were lined up on stage and whipped one after the other.
sentences.zh: 受害者在台上一字排开，一个接一个地被皮带抽打。

sentences.en: Parents were made to whip their children too.
sentences.zh: 父母也被迫鞭打自己的孩子。

sentences.en: If parents whipped gently to protect their child,
sentences.zh: 如果父母为了保护孩子而打得轻一些，

sentences.en: Jones called them disloyal.
sentences.zh: 琼斯就会说他们不忠诚。

sentences.en: Then the parent was whipped.
sentences.zh: 然后这位父母就会挨鞭子。

sentences.en: Once the belt became predictable and less effective, it was replaced by something known as the board of education.
sentences.zh: 当皮带变得可以预料且效果不如从前时，它被一种被称为教育板的东西所取代。

sentences.en: A one by four inch board, two and a half feet long.
sentences.zh: 一块一英寸乘四英寸、长两点五英尺的木板。

sentences.en: The board was used up to a hundred times in one catharsis.
sentences.zh: 在一场净化宣泄中，这块木板最多会被使用上百次。

sentences.en: If a child refused to stand still and accept their beating, two adults would hold them down.
sentences.zh: 如果孩子拒绝站着不动并接受殴打，两名成年人就会按住他们。

sentences.en: Children often collapsed afterwards and needed to be carried off stage.
sentences.zh: 孩子们经常在事后虚脱倒地，需要被人抬下台。

sentences.en: During one meeting,
sentences.zh: 在一次集会期间，

sentences.en: Jones ordered 16-year-old Linda Myrtle on stage.
sentences.zh: 琼斯命令16岁的琳达·默特尔上台。

sentences.en: Linda stood before the crowd of 700 Temple members, including her parents.
sentences.zh: 琳达站在700名圣殿教成员面前，其中包括她的父母。

sentences.en: Her crime was that she was seen greeting a female friend with a hug and a kiss.
sentences.zh: 她的罪名是被人看到用拥抱和亲吻的方式向女性朋友问好。

sentences.en: Linda was hit 75 times as the crowd yelled scathing words at her.
sentences.zh: 琳达被打了75下，台下的人群对她恶语相向。

sentences.en: The beating was so severe,
sentences.zh: 这顿打是如此残酷，

sentences.en: Linda couldn't sit for a week and a half afterwards.
sentences.zh: 以至于琳达在事后一个半星期里都无法坐着。

sentences.en: Younger, badly behaved children were subjected to the blue-eyed monster.
sentences.zh: 年幼且表现不乖的孩子则会沦为“蓝眼怪物”的惩罚对象。

sentences.en: The child was left in a dark room where a frightening voice told them,
sentences.zh: 孩子会被单独留在黑暗的房间里，一个可怕的声音会告诉他们：

sentences.en: I am the blue-eyed monster and I am going to get you.
sentences.zh: 我是蓝眼怪物，我要来抓你了。

sentences.en: Paddles of an electroshock therapy machine were pressed to the child's cheSt.
sentences.zh: 电休克疗法机器的电极板被按在孩子的胸口上。

sentences.en: A sharp jolt of electricity prickled through their body and the traumatised child was then used as a warning to others.
sentences.zh: 一股强烈的电流刺痛着他们的身体，然后这个受创的孩子就被当作警告其他人的典型。

sentences.en: Adult punishments progressed into boxing matches.
sentences.zh: 成年人的惩罚则升级为拳击比赛。

sentences.en: Multiple assailants beat troublemakers before the congregation.
sentences.zh: 多名袭击者在会众面前殴打惹麻烦的人。

sentences.en: It was considered cowardly if the victims defended themselves or fought back.
sentences.zh: 如果受害者自卫或还手，就会被认为是懦夫。

sentences.en: If knocked unconscious, the victim's face was splashed with water to wake them up.
sentences.zh: 如果被打得失去知觉，就会往受害者脸上泼水以将其弄醒。

sentences.en: Then the beating would continue.
sentences.zh: 然后殴打将继续进行。

sentences.en: After punishment,
sentences.zh: 惩罚结束后，

sentences.en: Reverend Jim Jones would wrap his arms around the victim and say,
sentences.zh: 吉姆·琼斯牧师会用双臂搂住受害者并说道：

sentences.en: I realised that you went through a lot but it was for the cause.
sentences.zh: 我意识到你经历了许多，但这都是为了事业。

sentences.en: Father loves you and you're a stronger person now.
sentences.zh: 父亲爱着你，现在的你是一个更坚强的人了。

sentences.en: I can trust you more now that you've gone through and accepted this discipline.
sentences.zh: 既然你已经经历了并接受了这种纪律，我现在可以更信任你了。

sentences.en: The victim was required to respond into the microphone.
sentences.zh: 受害者被要求对着麦克风回应。

sentences.en: Thank you, Father.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，父亲。

sentences.en: The abuse continued outside of the catharsis sessions.
sentences.zh: 这种虐待在净化宣泄环节之外仍在继续。

sentences.en: During temple meetings, doors would be locked and no one was allowed in or out.
sentences.zh: 在圣殿集会期间，大门会反锁，任何人不得出入。

sentences.en: Members were not allowed to talk, go to the bathroom, or sleep.
sentences.zh: 成员不准说话、上厕所或睡觉。

sentences.en: Guards carrying guns walked through the sanctuary threatening and separating talkers.
sentences.zh: 携带枪支的卫兵在圣殿里巡逻，威胁并隔离说话的人。

sentences.en: They roughly woke up worshippers who fell asleep.
sentences.zh: 他们粗暴地叫醒睡着的崇拜者。

sentences.en: Some temple members wet their pants during the meetings, unable to hold on until the end.
sentences.zh: 一些圣殿成员在集会期间尿了裤子，因为他们撑不到结束。

sentences.en: If caught chewing gum, members were thrown into the church's swimming pool.
sentences.zh: 如果被抓到嚼口香糖，成员会被扔进教会的游泳池里。

sentences.en: When one child threw up,
sentences.zh: 当一个孩子呕吐时，

sentences.en: Jones ordered the child to eat their vomit.
sentences.zh: 琼斯命令这个孩子吃掉自己的呕吐物。

sentences.en: A misbehaving three-year-old boy was forced to stay up all night scrubbing floors with a toothbrush.
sentences.zh: 一个表现不乖的三岁男孩被迫整夜不睡，用牙刷擦洗地板。

sentences.en: Teenagers were made to pick lint off carpet floors for hours.
sentences.zh: 青少年被迫从地毯上挑出线头达数小时之久。

sentences.en: Members were stripped naked in meetings and their bodies criticised.
sentences.zh: 成员在集会上被扒光衣服，他们的身体遭到评头论足。

sentences.en: One exhausted man was vomited and urinated on when he accidentally fell asleep.
sentences.zh: 一个疲惫不堪的男人不小心睡着后，被人吐了满身并被尿在身上。

sentences.en: These meetings would go on all night with several meetings held per week.
sentences.zh: 这些会议会通宵达旦地进行，每周要举行好几次。

sentences.en: Some followers dismissed concerns about the abusive behaviour within the temple as they believed the ends justified the means.
sentences.zh: 一些追随者对圣殿内部虐待行为的担忧不屑一顾，因为他们相信目的可以将手段合理化。

sentences.en: Others were scared into silence.
sentences.zh: 另一些人则被吓得噤若寒蝉。

sentences.en: No one wanted to be called up on stage and beaten for criticising the church.
sentences.zh: 没有人愿意因为批评教会而被叫上台殴打。

sentences.en: They stripped members of free will and thought.
sentences.zh: 他们剥夺了成员的自由意志和思想。

sentences.en: Eventually, even the most shocking acts became normal.
sentences.zh: 最终，就连最令人震惊的行为也成了司空见惯的事。

sentences.en: One night,
sentences.zh: 一天晚上，

sentences.en: Jones ordered an urgent meeting with the Planning Commission.
sentences.zh: 琼斯下令与规划委员会召开紧急会议。

sentences.en: After the defections,
sentences.zh: 在发生叛逃事件后，

sentences.en: Jones wanted to determine how loyal his remaining followers were.
sentences.zh: 琼斯想要测验他剩下的追随者有多忠诚。

sentences.en: Jones claimed that if his followers were loyal, they should be willing to jump off the Golden Gate Bridge for the cause.
sentences.zh: 琼斯声称，如果他的追随者是忠诚的，他们应该愿意为了事业从金门大桥上跳下去。

sentences.en: He suggested filling buses with temple members and driving them off the Golden Gate Bridge.
sentences.zh: 他建议用大巴车装满圣殿成员，然后把车开下金门大桥。

sentences.en: After a long silence,
sentences.zh: 经过长久的沉默之后，

sentences.en: Jack Beam, who had been alongside Jones since Indiana, yelled,
sentences.zh: 自印第安纳州起就一直跟随琼斯的杰克·比姆大喊道：

sentences.en: Go ahead and kill yourself if you want, but leave the rest of us out of this.
sentences.zh: 如果你想自杀就自己去，别把我们其他人扯进来。

sentences.en: No,
sentences.zh: 不，

sentences.en: Jones responded.
sentences.zh: 琼斯回答道。

sentences.en: He would be the only survivor.
sentences.zh: 他将是唯一的幸存者。

sentences.en: He'd remain behind to explain to the world why the temple chose to commit revolutionary suicide.
sentences.zh: 他将留在后面，向世界解释为什么圣殿选择进行革命性自杀。

sentences.en: Revolutionary suicide was coined in the late 1960s by Huey Newton.
sentences.zh: “革命性自杀”一词是由休伊·牛顿在20世纪60年代末提出的。

sentences.en: Newton was the leader of the Black Panther Party.
sentences.zh: 牛顿是黑豹党的领袖。

sentences.en: Newton spoke of revolutionary suicide in relation to assassinations of Black Panther members by police and public enemies.
sentences.zh: 牛顿在谈到黑豹党成员遭到警察和公众敌人的暗杀时，提到了革命性自杀。

sentences.en: Newton said these murders were a consequence of challenging the system, standing up against the power of the man.
sentences.zh: 牛顿表示，这些谋杀是挑战体制、反抗当权者力量的后果。

sentences.en: The man will shoot you down.
sentences.zh: 当权者会开枪击倒你。

sentences.en: Death is a sacrifice for the cause.
sentences.zh: 死亡是为了事业做出的牺牲。

sentences.en: It was revolutionary suicide.
sentences.zh: 这就是革命性自杀。

sentences.en: Jim Jones' interpretation of revolutionary suicide was completely different.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·琼斯对革命性自杀的理解完全不同。

sentences.en: According to Jones, revolutionary suicide was a voluntary act committed by members of a cause to make a political statement.
sentences.zh: 根据琼斯的说法，革命性自杀是某个事业的成员为了表达政治诉求而自愿实施的行为。

sentences.en: Newton never considered revolutionary suicide a choice.
sentences.zh: 牛顿从未将革命性自杀视为一种选择。

sentences.en: Jim Jones did.
sentences.zh: 但吉姆·琼斯将其视为选择。

sentences.en: On New Year's Day 1976, the People's Temple
sentences.zh: 1976年元旦，人民圣殿教

sentences.en: Planning Commission were in the church sanctuary celebrating.
sentences.zh: 计划委员会正在教堂圣所内庆祝。

sentences.en: Jones was on stage and beside him were dozens of glasses sitting in neat rows on a tray.
sentences.zh: 琼斯站在台上，他身旁托盘里整齐地摆放着数十个杯子。

sentences.en: Purple-coloured wine was poured into each glass.
sentences.zh: 每个杯子里都倒上了紫色的葡萄酒。

sentences.en: Jones had permitted the Planning Commission members to consume alcohol for the special occasion.
sentences.zh: 琼斯允许计划委员会成员在这个特殊的日子里饮酒。

sentences.en: Each party-goer took a glass and within seconds the glasses were empty.
sentences.zh: 每个参加聚会的人都拿了一个杯子，几秒钟内杯子就空了。

sentences.en: Jones' voice boomed over the happy chatter.
sentences.zh: 琼斯的声音在欢乐的交谈声中轰然响起。

sentences.en: You just drank poison.
sentences.zh: 你们刚喝下的是毒药。

sentences.en: People were stunned, eyes wired and shaking.
sentences.zh: 人们惊呆了，双眼圆睁，浑身发抖。

sentences.en: Elderly people felt faint.
sentences.zh: 老年人感到头晕目眩。

sentences.en: Should anyone leave to seek a doctor, they'd be traitors,
sentences.zh: 如果有人离开去寻求医生，他们就是叛徒，

sentences.en: Jones announced.
sentences.zh: 琼斯宣布道。

sentences.en: One woman ran to the door but was forced back by armed guards.
sentences.zh: 一名女子跑向门口，但被武装警卫强行逼退。

sentences.en: As panic swept through the sanctuary,
sentences.zh: 当恐慌席卷整个圣所时，

sentences.en: Jones watched with staunch indifference.
sentences.zh: 琼斯却冷漠以对，无动于衷。

sentences.en: Forty-five minutes after drinking the poisoned wine, everyone remained well.
sentences.zh: 喝下毒酒四十五分钟后，所有人都安然无恙。

sentences.en: The party suspected they had been fooled.
sentences.zh: 聚会的人怀疑他们被耍了。

sentences.en: Jones said, That wasn't poison you drank.
sentences.zh: 琼斯说：“你们刚才喝的不是毒药。

sentences.en: I had my staff watching each of your thirty faces to determine if you were indeed ready to die.
sentences.zh: 我让工作人员观察了你们三十个人的脸，以确定你们是否真的准备好去死。

sentences.en: Anyone seen clinging to life was chastised.
sentences.zh: 任何被发现留恋生命的人都受到了斥责。

sentences.en: It was a privilege to die for your beliefs.
sentences.zh: 为信仰而死是一种特权。”

sentences.en: The idea of his followers dying for his cause became an obsession for Jim Jones.
sentences.zh: 让追随者为他的事业去死的想法成了吉姆·琼斯的痴迷。

sentences.en: His sermons were suddenly peppered with ominous statements about killing his congregation.
sentences.zh: 他的布道中突然充斥着关于杀死信众的不祥言论。

sentences.en: When Jones boasted of his love of socialism, he added,
sentences.zh: 当琼斯吹嘘自己对社会主义的热爱时，他补充道：

sentences.en: I'd be willing to die to bring it about but if I did,
sentences.zh: “我愿意为实现它而死，但如果我死了，

sentences.en: I'd take a thousand with me.
sentences.zh: 我会带上一千个人陪葬。”

sentences.en: He also said,
sentences.zh: 他还说：

sentences.en: The last orgasm
sentences.zh: “如果能带上你们所有人一起上路，

sentences.en: I'd like to have is death if I could take you all with me.
sentences.zh: 我最后想得到的极乐就是死亡。

sentences.en: The day is coming when I'm going to issue an order that will shock you.
sentences.zh: 这一天即将来临，我将下一道让你们震惊的命令。”

sentences.en: With his hands deep in politician pockets,
sentences.zh: 凭借深厚的政客关系网，

sentences.en: Jim Jones and his temple were able to live and prosper in San Francisco without government intervention or questioning.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·琼斯和他的圣殿得以在旧金山生存和繁荣，不受政府干预或质疑。

sentences.en: One politician who owed Jim Jones was George Moscone.
sentences.zh: 欠吉姆·琼人人情的政客之一就是乔治·莫斯康尼。

sentences.en: Jones had temple members campaign on behalf of Moscone leading to him getting elected as the mayor of San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 琼斯让圣殿成员代表莫斯康尼竞选，从而助其当选旧金山市长。

sentences.en: Moscone rewarded
sentences.zh: 莫斯康尼回报了

sentences.en: Jones with the role of chairman of the housing authority.
sentences.zh: 琼斯，任命他担任住房管理局局长。

sentences.en: The housing authority city hall meetings were previously uneventful affairs but when Jones was appointed chairman, meetings turned into bizarre spectacles.
sentences.zh: 住房管理局的市政厅会议以前都很平静，但当琼斯被任命为主席后，会议变成了一场怪异的闹剧。

sentences.en: Jones wore his trademark sunglasses and arrived to meetings with an entourage of aides, bodyguards and his own audience.
sentences.zh: 琼斯戴着他标志性的太阳镜来到会场，随行人员包括助手、保镖以及他自己的听众。

sentences.en: When Jones spoke, his planted audience would erupt in loud applause and standing ovations.
sentences.zh: 当琼斯发言时，他安插的观众会爆发热烈的掌声和全体起立致敬。

sentences.en: These unruly meetings caught the curiosity of the media and people's temple suddenly found themselves under constant media scrutiny.
sentences.zh: 这些无序的会议引起了媒体的好奇，人民圣殿教突然发现自己处于媒体的持续密切监督之下。

sentences.en: Journalists began investigating people's temple.
sentences.zh: 记者们开始调查人民圣殿教。

sentences.en: One journalist watched Jones faith heal the same person of the same illness twice in one day.
sentences.zh: 一名记者看着琼斯在一天内两次治愈了同一个人身上的同一种疾病。

sentences.en: Jones had once admitted publicly to being an atheiSt.
sentences.zh: 琼斯曾公开承认自己是个无神论者。

sentences.en: He didn't believe in God but his church was exempt from paying tax by claiming to be a religious institution.
sentences.zh: 他不相信上帝，但他的教会通过声称自己是宗教机构而免缴税款。

sentences.en: Journalists exposed this hypocrisy.
sentences.zh: 记者们揭露了这种虚伪行径。

sentences.en: Suddenly, journalists were receiving dozens of calls a day from temple members telling them not to criticise Jones.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，记者们每天都会接到数十通来自圣殿成员的电话，警告他们不要批评琼斯。

sentences.en: Members even picketed the offices of journalists and pressured advertisers not to buy space in these publications.
sentences.zh: 成员们甚至在记者办公室外进行抗议，并向广告商施压，要求他们不要在这些刊物上买版面。

sentences.en: However, the temple's threats had the adverse impact.
sentences.zh: 然而，圣殿的威胁适得其反。

sentences.en: It compelled journalists to keep digging which led them to the discovery of seven suspicious deaths of people's temple members.
sentences.zh: 它迫使记者们继续深入挖掘，从而发现了人民圣殿教成员七起可疑死亡事件。

sentences.en: Maxine Harp was found hanged in her garage in March 1970.
sentences.zh: 马克辛·哈普于1970年3月被发现死在车库中。

sentences.en: The death ruled a suicide.
sentences.zh: 死因被裁定为自杀。

sentences.en: Maxine knew temple members had infiltrated government agencies including the welfare department.
sentences.zh: 马克辛知道圣殿成员已经渗透到政府机构，包括福利部门。

sentences.en: The temple were purposefully disbanding families and putting the children into temple-owned foster care homes.
sentences.zh: 圣殿在蓄意解散家庭，并将儿童送入圣殿名下的寄养家庭。

sentences.en: This made the children eligible for welfare support which the temple collected on their behalf.
sentences.zh: 这使得孩子们有资格获得福利金，而圣殿则代为领取。

sentences.en: Maxine confronted
sentences.zh: 马克辛当面质问

sentences.en: Jones who told her why don't you just kill yourself get it over with.
sentences.zh: 琼斯，琼斯对她说：“你怎么不去自杀，一了百了呢。”

sentences.en: Jones predicted the day before
sentences.zh: 在马克辛死前的

sentences.en: Maxine's death that bitch is going to die.
sentences.zh: 前一天，琼斯预测：“那个贱人要死了。”

sentences.en: After her death
sentences.zh: 在她死后，

sentences.en: Maxine's three children were put into temple foster homes.
